jobs.description:
Join our team at The Redwoods, where you can make a meaningful impact on individual lives. After more than 50 years as a local, nonprofit community in beautiful Mill Valley, we have a rich history of service and purpose. We take pride in providing excellent care for an active and diverse community of seniors. You'll find that every day presents an opportunity for a rewarding experience of caring and connection with a dedicated team and dynamic group of residents. As a mission driven organization, we ensure everyone receives vital programs and services regardless of their income. Enjoy competitive pay, first class health benefits, generous vacation and sick time, and a great work environment.

Be a part of something bigger - join us in making a genuine difference!

**Rate**

$27.00 per hour

**Schedule - 20 Hours**

Tues. and Fri. = 9:00am to 5:30pm/ Thurs. = 9:00am to 1:00pm

**\*\*\*Benefits**

* **Medical Insurance:** ZERO out-of-pocket expense for the employee – effective the first of the month following the hire date.
* **Dental and Vision Insurance**
* **Paid Time Off:** Sick days, personal days, vacation days and holidays.
* **403(b) Retirement Plan:** Employer contribution/Union pension contributions.
* **Additional Perks:** Educational assistance & career development opportunities, longevity bonus program and low-cost meal program.

*\*\*\* For positions scheduled 24 or more hours per week.*

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Working in close collaboration with the Director of Life Enrichment and Transportation, the Art Program Coordinator maintains an active art program for the residents in all levels of care and overseeing the art room.

**PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Plan, facilitate, and lead art groups and classes that support residents’ emotional expression, cognitive engagement, purpose, and overall quality of life, in alignment with The Redwoods’ Life Enrichment philosophy.
* Develop individualized and small-group art experiences responsive to residents across levels of care, including Memory Care and Health Care Center, adapting approaches to varying abilities and needs.
* Oversee the art department and studio space, ensuring the room is safe, organized, welcoming, and equipped to support creative and therapeutic engagement.
* Maintain art supplies, tools, and adaptive materials; recommend and coordinate purchases as needed under the supervision of the Director of Life Enrichment & Transportation.
* Collaborate with Life Enrichment staff, care teams, and interdisciplinary partners to integrate art therapy into broader wellness and psychosocial programming.
* Provide routine program updates, including participation trends, resident feedback, and therapeutic observations, to support continuous program improvement.
* Maintain confidentiality of all resident information in accordance with HIPAA and The Redwoods’ policies; attend required meetings, training, and in-services as assigned.
* Coordinate intergenerational projects, performances, and showcases that connect residents with the broader community.
* Develop opportunities for residents to share their artistic talents, experiences, and creativity through community events and exhibits.

**QUALIFICATIONS / MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS**

* Must be at least 18 years of age.
* Associate’s degree in fine art, art education, art therapy or relevant area is required. Equivalent
* professional experience in activities coordination or community art is acceptable. Bachelor’s degree is preferred.
* Prior experience working with seniors preferred, including an understanding of therapeutic methods applied to art activities for the frail elderly.
* Experience teaching art techniques and classes is required.
* Safety knowledge: understanding health protocols, non-toxic art materials, and facility safety rules.

*The Redwoods is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Pendulum**

Pendulum® is leading a revolution that is occurring around the world to improve physical and mental health by first understanding, then restoring and enhancing the human microbiome.

Studies have shown that our microbiome (the bacterial communities in and on our bodies) is linked to everything from metabolism and diabetes, to longevity, weight loss, healthy immune systems, cancer prevention, feelings of well-being, inflammatory bowel disease, and even healthy skin. We have just scratched the surface on understanding the impact that our microbiome has on our lives. During early life we develop a diverse and balanced microbiome that plays a critical role in shaping our long-term health. Over our lives, a combination of diet, lifestyle, antibiotics, and aging can decrease the effectiveness of our microbiome.

Pendulum recognized the enormous impact they could have on people’s lives if they were able to address the imbalances in the microbiome. To accomplish this, Pendulum created proprietary probiotic pipelines and a unique discovery platform to identify key, novel bacterial strains and the prebiotics that feed them. The company has also built and developed the world’s first manufacturing technology to produce bacteria in an anaerobic (oxygen-free) environment at scale.

The medical probiotics that Pendulum has formulated have transformed the consumer probiotics market into a new category of therapeutic offerings that deliver the power and efficacy of a pharmaceutical with the safety and accessibility of a natural probiotic. Due to Pendulum’s explosive revenue and customer growth over the last two years, the company earned a spot on Forbes Magazine’s exclusive “The Next Billion Dollar Startups” list.

If you’re interested in improving the lives of people globally and you love working in a cross-functional, collaborative, inspiring environment, please continue reading.

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for an organized, proactive Project Coordinator to join our Product team. You'll work closely with the Program Manager to keep projects moving, supporting Supply Chain and other cross-functional initiatives such as supplier onboarding, packaging changes and new product launches. You'll be the person who keeps the details in order: agendas drafted, files organized, deliverables tracked, and issues flagged early.

We’re looking for someone who’s energized by the pace and possibility of a fast-growing, mission-driven company. You thrive in a collaborative, nimble environment where ideas are shaped through iteration, feedback, and shared vision. You’re not just a big thinker—you’re also a creative problem-solver who knows how to make things happen with limited resources. If you're excited by the opportunity to help shape a young brand from the ground up, and passionate about building something with purpose, you'll feel right at home here.

### **What You'll Do**

* Support day-to-day coordination and management of Supply Chain and other cross-functional projects, including supplier onboarding, packaging changes and new product launches
* Draft meeting agendas, capture notes and action items, and distribute follow-ups
* Monitor daily progress on project deliverables and flag risks, delays, or blockers to the Program Manager
* Maintain project documentation, keeping files, trackers, and shared folders organized, current, and easy to find
* Update project plans, timelines, and status reports
* Schedule meetings and coordinate availability across internal teams and external partners
* Work cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Regulatory, Quality, Finance, Product, and Marketing
* Serve as the main point of contact between team members and the Program Manager.
* Draft and update SOPs and checklists as workflows change
* Help run project kickoffs and retrospectives, and capture lessons learned
* Help identify opportunities to improve project processes and templates.

### **What You’ll Need**

**Experience**

* 1-3 years of experience in project management in operations, supply chain, procurement or a similar role
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
* Comfort working with data in spreadsheets (sorting, filtering, formulas, lookups)
* Proficiency with Google Workspace

**Skills**

* Organization: Multitasking and managing daily details across multiple workflows
* Communication: Clear verbal and written updates for stakeholders and teams
* Time Management: Keeping fast-moving tasks aligned with deadlines
* Technical Proficiency: Using scheduling frameworks (like Gantt charts), spreadsheets, and project management tools

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting product launches or supplier/vendor onboarding
* Exposure to supply chain, procurement, or consumer products
* Familiarity with ERP or inventory systems (such as NetSuite) or purchase order workflows

jobs.description:
**Case Manager (Anchor Village)**

**In-Person Full-Time (40 hours per week) Position in Alameda, CA (Non-Exempt)**

**Who We Are**

Ruby's Place dba Restorative Pathways (RP) is an innovative nonprofit committed to ending domestic violence, human trafficking, and violent crime through hope, advocacy and connection. Our services include emergency shelter, transitional housing, rental subsidies, mental health services, substance recovery, and wrap-around services. All our services are trauma-sensitive and client-centered and are provided at no cost to our clients. All programs are low barrier.

RP is led by survivors with a focus on reflection, innovation, and connection. We believe in fostering relationships, both in our direct service work and throughout our internal work culture. We aim to cultivate a workplace that appreciates and emphasizes the voices of those most impacted by violence. We recognize these voices are vital to interrupting the cycle of violence and transforming lives towards safety, unity, and trust.

**Who You Are**

You have a strong commitment to preventing interpersonal violence as well as an understanding of, and sensitivity to, serving diverse populations. You have excellent interpersonal skills and strong techniques for relationship building. You believe people should determine their own path towards healing, and have an orientation towards survivor-centered services.

You are a go-getter who enjoys fast paced environments. You enjoy working both collaboratively and independently. You are adept at time management and highly organized with a proven ability to ensure you can meet deadlines, plan, organize and execute. You are comfortable working as part of a team and are an accountable collaborator. You excel at organizing, prioritizing, and following through on multiple time-sensitive projects. You are flexible, creative, and take initiative in handling emergencies.

***What qualifications are required for this position?***

You also have:

* A Bachelor’s degree in social work, human services, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience may be considered.
* Minimum of two years of experience providing case management or direct services to individuals experiencing homelessness or housing instability.
* Knowledge of community resources, housing programs, and benefits systems preferred.
* Experience with HMIS or other data management systems preferred.
* Strong communication, engagement, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work effectively with individuals experiencing crisis or complex needs.

* Experience working in shelter programs, drop-in centers, or outreach programs serving individuals experiencing homelessness.
* Knowledge of trauma-informed care, harm reduction, and housing-first approaches

* A valid CA driver's license, proof of insurance, and be approved by RP insurance as a driver in order to drive agency vehicles. If a staff member cannot be approved by RP insurance as a driver, employment might not be able to continue. Instances where staff cannot be approved to drive will be reviewed on a case by case basis to determine if employment can continue in their role without driving agency vehicles. Items considered include but are not limited to: the shift the staff member holds and the frequency/necessity of driving during that shift, the amount of time before the staff member may be approved to drive by the insurance carrier, the availability of other staff on site to drive agency vehicles as program needs require, etc.
* Ability to complete all required background checks. Additional requirements may be deemed necessary, including fingerprinting (Live Scan), completion of all Community Care Licensing (CCL) documents, and ability to meet CCL licensing requirements.

**What You Will Do**

The Case Manager provides direct services to individuals accessing Anchor Village (Day Center, Night Shelter & Safe Park program). This role focuses on supporting participants in addressing immediate needs, identifying barriers to stability, and connecting them to housing resources, benefits, and supportive services. The Case Manager works collaboratively with program staff to ensure participants receive coordinated, participant-centered support aimed at promoting stability and pathways toward housing.

The Case Manager plays a critical role in engaging individuals experiencing homelessness, conducting assessments, developing service plans, and supporting participants in accessing resources that support long-term housing and overall well-being. This position requires strong engagement skills, a trauma-informed approach, and experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness or housing instability.

***Responsibilities include***

**Participant Engagement and Assessment**

* Engage participants accessing Anchor Village to assess needs and identify service priorities.
* Conduct intake assessments and gather relevant information related to housing history, service needs, and barriers to stability.
* Build trusting relationships with participants through respectful and trauma-informed engagement.

**Service Planning and Case Management**

* Develop individualized service plans with participants focused on housing stability and access to supportive resources.
* Provide ongoing case management support including regular meetings with participants to monitor progress and address barriers.
* Assist participants in accessing community resources such as healthcare, employment services, benefits, identification services, and other supports.

**Housing Navigation and Resource Connection**

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

We serve our community of users and customers by working tirelessly to preserve free expression and choice, create limitless interactivity, and maintain a safe digital marketplace. The Safety Integrity Program Manager, Regulated & Prohibited Content will drive priorities, measures, and system health for regulated and prohibited content, owning program standards and execution across upstream systems and downstream operations.

You are an experienced program manager with a strong background in content integrity, enforcement, or risk programs at scale. You are skilled at setting requirements for detection and automation, translating policy and legal constraints into practical workflows and controls, and driving cross-functional partners to improve coverage, precision, and enforcement quality. You thrive in fast-paced environments and excel at turning operational signals into lasting improvements.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Drive priorities, measures, and system health for regulated and prohibited content, and continuously improve execution
* Set requirements and success criteria for detection and automation, and drive Product, Engineering, and Operations to improve coverage, precision, and enforcement quality at scale.
* Translate legal, policy, and technical constraints into practical requirements, workflows, controls, and escalation paths for Product, Engineering, and Operations.
* Identify gaps in the current framework and drive enhancements to policies, procedures, controls, and workflows.
* Own escalations, quality assurance, and complex case patterns for residual volume, and use those signals to harden standards and automation over time.
* Align and drive Product, Engineering, Policy, Legal, and Operations partners to resolve dependencies, make decisions, and move critical work forward with clear accountable ownership.
* Build and maintain the documentation, guidance, and operating standards that embed consistent execution across the program.
* Monitor relevant regulatory developments, assess impact on the program, and ensure requirements stay accurate and executable.
* Track and report operational performance, risks, and improvement opportunities with clear recommendations for leadership

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 5+ years in content integrity, safety operations, compliance operations, or related program roles supporting enforcement or risk programs at scale.
* Experience owning or supporting program priorities, measures, and operational health for content or risk domains.
* Working knowledge of regulated or prohibited content areas and how policy, legal, and technical constraints shape enforcement.
* Experience translating policy or legal requirements into practical workflows, controls, and escalation paths.
* Experience working with automated or model-driven enforcement systems, including detection, classifiers, or policy automation.
* Proven ability to drive cross-functional work with Product, Engineering, Policy, Legal, and Operations partners.
* Strong analytical skills with experience using operational data to identify gaps, prioritize interventions, and track outcomes.
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to brief leadership and document standards, decisions, and recommendations.

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Direct experience with regulated or prohibited content programs.
* Experience setting requirements for detection, classifiers, or automation and partnering with Product or Engineering teams on outcomes.
* Experience owning escalations, quality assurance, or residual case handling for enforcement programs.
* Familiarity with regulatory developments affecting online platforms and content enforcement.
* Exposure to integrity risks involving synthetic content, model misuse, or scaled manipulation.
* Experience improving operating standards, documentation, and controls in a live program environment.
* Background in high-scale consumer platforms, marketplaces, or technology products.

### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**

$110,000 - $145,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

* To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. The Operations Manager is an exempt position whose primary responsibility is the operational success of the Club through the on-going creation and/or development of staff, programs, services and facilities. The Operations Manager oversees the Front Desk, as well as provides leadership to all Associates to ensure that member needs are met and that the experience that we deliver surpasses expectations. ***Our Culture***

Our unique culture is at the heart of all we do and is guided by our values and behaviors. It's what we expect of ourselves and each other every day. We call it our “Code of Culture”.

Respect The Past

Accept Responsibility

Pay it Forward

**Think Ahead. Be An Owner.** Always be proactive, not reactive; be on the front foot. If we want to be an owner of this business, we must act like it!

Service Forward

jobs.description:
**Care Operations Manager**

  

**Location:** San Jose / Los Gatos, CA (In-Office & Local Field Visits)

  

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

  

**Compensation:** *$27 - $36 per hour, depending on experience.*

  

**Benefits:** 401(k) with 3% company match (upon eligibility), Paid Time Off (PTO), Paid Sick Leave, Weekly Pay with Direct Deposit, Mileage Reimbursement for business travel, Opportunities to Grow with the Company.

  

**About the Role**

Are you an experienced operations leader passionate about elevating standards in healthcare and home services?

At **BrightStar Care of East Los Gatos & South San Jose**, we deliver *A Higher Standard* of non-medical home care. We are seeking a proactive, detail-driven **Care Operations Manager** to lead our day-to-day operations, drive caregiver recruitment and retention, ensure clinical/regulatory compliance, and maintain exceptional client satisfaction across our community.

In this role, you will partner directly with the Owner and Director of Nursing to oversee field care teams, optimize scheduling, manage administrative and financial workflows, and foster a culture of empathy, accountability, and excellence.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Team Leadership & Talent Management****:**

* **Recruitment & Hiring:** Drive the full-cycle recruitment pipeline (online postings, community outreach, fast-paced phone screening, and interviewing) to attract top-tier Home Care Aides, DSPs, and other staff as needed.
* **Onboarding & Credentialing:** Ensure 100% pre-hire compliance before placement (CDSS Home Care Aide Registry clearance, Live Scan, TB testing, and credentials).
* **Training & Mentorship:** Lead new employee orientations in partnership with the Director of Nursing; foster a culture of positive coaching, regular performance reviews, and progressive discipline when necessary.
* **Schedule Optimization:** Oversee weekly caregiver scheduling with an emphasis on client-caregiver matching, shift consistency, and overtime control.
* **On-Call Rotation Coverage:** Share in remote after-hours phone coverage in a rotating capacity (every other week) to handle employee call outs, emergency service incidents, and new client inquiries.

  

**Client Relations & Service Delivery****:**

* **Intake & Assessments:** Respond to new client inquiries with urgency and empathy; participate in initial in-home assessments and service authorizations.
* **Quality Assurance:** Conduct regular supervisory check-ins, home visits, and \"warm handoffs\" introducing new caregivers on their first shifts.
* **Emergency Escalation:** Serve as an operational escalation point, maintaining contingency plans for call-outs (and providing emergency hands-on care coverage as a critical last resort).

  

**Operations, Compliance & Finance****:**

* **Regulatory Compliance:** Maintain full operational compliance with California Department of Social Services (CDSS) Home Care Services regulations, HIPAA, Cal/OSHA standards, Joint Commission accreditation requirements, and BrightStar Care standards.
* **Billing & Payroll:** Process weekly payroll with high accuracy; generate client invoicing and manage active accounts receivable collections.
* **Financial Management:** Monitor operational expenditures to achieve target margins, utilizing lowest-cost/highest-quality vendors and minimizing avoidable overtime.

  

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 2–4+ years of leadership or operations management experience, preferably in home care, healthcare staffing, assisted living, or another in-home services industry.
* **Staff Scheduling:** Demonstrated success managing and scheduling a distributed, multi-tier workforce (full-time, part-time, per diem).
* **Education:** Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, or related field is preferred
* **Technical Skills:** Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint), AI programs, and experience navigating scheduling/EHR platforms. Effective writing and communication skills.
* **Licensing & Requirements:**
* + Valid California Driver’s License, clean driving record, and active auto insurance.
  + Reliable personal vehicle for local client visits, field check-ins, and community outreach.
  + Current CPR/First Aid certification (or willingness to obtain prior to start).
  + Ability to clear a CDSS Live Scan criminal background check (DOJ/FBI), exclusion lists search, and TB clearance.

  

*BrightStar Care of East Los Gatos & South San Jose is an independently owned and operated franchise location. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, ethnicity, gender, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class under federal, state, or local law.*

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; San Bruno, CA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience in a management consulting, sales operations, business strategy, or corporate advisory role.
* 5 years of experience working with executive stakeholders.
* Experience working with Google Ads Suite and Google Measurement solutions, or with participant platforms in the industry.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree, MBA, or advanced degree.
* Experience designing commercial policies, rate card strategies, or governance frameworks that resolve channel conflict and balance platform incentives.
* Expertise in digital video advertising ecosystems, ad serving mechanics (e.g., Google Ad Manager 360, FreeWheel), programmatic sales, and publisher monetization models.
* Track record of applying systems thinking to navigate complex contractual, legal, and compliance structures (e.g., affiliate structures, multi-party licensing).
* Track record of integrating AI tools and advanced operational frameworks into workflows to scale team impact and operational efficiency.
* Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

As a Sales Operations Manager, you will own decision-making and execution for large, complex initiatives and commercial deliverables across YouTube Partnerships, Large Partner Solutions (LPS), Product, and the Global Business Organization. You will provide thought leadership around commercial frameworks, go-to-market (GTM) structures, and rate card governance using systems thinking.

In this role, you will uncover and resolve complex, unprecedented business problems—such as evolving sales house structures, programmatic guaranteed cross-sell models, and publisher inventory protection—while anticipating future industry and macroeconomic headwinds. You will break ambiguous challenges into structured work streams, influence direction, and persuade and challenge senior executive stakeholders (VP+) to ensure alignment on solutions that protect YouTube’s ecosystem and drive sustainable growth for Google. Beyond steering strategy, you will serve as a people leader and cultural pillar—scaling operational excellence, developing high-performing talent, driving AI-enabled operational transformation, and fostering a collaborative environment.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $234000 - $325000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Direct strategy, scoping, and execution for monetization models, global rate cards, publisher margins, and formats.
* Resolve complex operational challenges including sales house enablement, contract strategy, inventory rights, and ad server integrations (GAM 360, FreeWheel).
* Evolve operating models, agreement evaluation, and activation workflows, partnering with PSE to automate onboarding and eliminate bottlenecks. Align senior cross-functional leaders (VP+) across Partnerships, Sales, Legal, Finance, and Product to balance publisher-sold inventory with Google demand.
* Use data tools to track ecosystem health, regional revenue, and attribution. Drive AI adoption to streamline analysis, forecasting, reporting, and global knowledge sharing.
* Hire, mentor, and build problem-solving capabilities within a high-performing commercial strategy team.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

Want to help pets live their best lives?

We’re proud to be where the pets go and where the *pet people* go. If you want to make a real difference, create an exciting career path, feel welcome to be your whole self and nurture your wellbeing, **Petco is the place for you**.

Our core values capture that spirit as we work to improve lives by doing what’s right for pets and people.

* **Pet First – Protect & Empower.** All pets should **Live their Best Life.** We put the needs of pets and pet parents at the center of everything we do.
* **Foster the Fun – Connect & Bond.** Our **Passion** for pets brings us together! We celebrate the journey of pet parenthood through district experiences, products, and services.
* **Let’s Go! Own & Commit.** We are stronger as **One Petco team.** We bring our unique superpowers and champion authenticity in everyone to drive success.

About Petco:

We’re proud to be **"where the pets go"** to find everything they need to live their best lives for more than 60 years — from their favorite meals and toys, to trusted supplies and expert support from people who get it, because we live it. We believe in the universal truths of pet parenthood — the boundless boops, missing slippers, late night zoomies and everything in between. And we’re here for it. Every tail wag, every vet visit, every step of the way. We are **29,000+** strong and together we nurture the pet-human bond in more than **1,500** Petco stores across the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico, **250+** Vetco Total Care hospitals, hundreds of preventive care clinics and eight distribution centers. In 1999, we founded Petco Love. Together, we support thousands of local animal welfare groups nationwide and have helped find homes for approximately **7 million animals** through in-store adoption events.

The purpose of the Hospital Operations Manager is to provide daily leadership to our hospital and partner with Hospital Veterinarian(s). The Hospital Operations Manager partners with our retail store partners to provide a smooth and profitable operation by creating a culture of high-quality patient care and exceptional customer service, as well as driving revenue and managing costs. The Hospital Operations Manager represents the mission and values of the hospital and Petco to all clients. Our partners are empowered to do what it takes to create an exceptional client and patient experience. The Hospital Operations Manager coordinates the overall operations of the hospital and cultivates a supportive and collaborative team environment by fostering cohesion and motivation within the team. If you have a passion for pet health and wellbeing, we’d love to have you on our team!

* Lead hospital paraprofessionals to drive operational excellence, efficiency, high standard patient care and excellent client experience.
* Create productive, collaborative and seamless relationships with all veterinarians in the hospital to drive a positive culture and cohesive team environment.
* Point person for all day-to-day functions of the practice including, but not limited to – veterinarian and support partners scheduling, equipment function and maintenance, inventory control and ordering, proper invoicing, patient scheduling, team training, radiological safety program and handling elevated client concerns.
* Oversee hiring, training, reviewing, counseling and separation of paraprofessional partners, in partnership with AOM (Area Operations Manager) and Human Resources Business Partner.
* Assume scheduling responsibilities for all paraprofessional partners, with the expectation to schedule a minimum of two weeks out. Maintain all hospital partner points in accordance with Petco’s punctuality and attendance policy.
* Create and maintain doctor’s schedule with support from Area or Regional Medical Director as needed.
* Review P&L monthly reporting, and partner with Area Operations Manager to increase revenue growth and exceed financial targets set by Finance team.
* Escalate partner or client issues to Area Operations Manager, Area Medical Director and/or HRBP as required.
* Interface and collaborate with Petco store team to drive a seamless complete care customer experience.
* Schedule appointments, provide client education, relay test results to doctor and clients, maintain and update hospital inventory, maintain client/patient records within the practice management system and manage accounts receivable.
* Keep hospital environment neat and clean; maintain OSHA standards, perform and maintain regular cleaning of environment based on necessity as well as based on a pre-determined maintenance schedule
* Uphold and enforce all policies of Petco and Vetco Total Care.

**Other Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Patient care always comes first.

* Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned.

Raising Cane’s is the fastest-growing chicken concept around and is on track to be a Top 10 Restaurant Brand in the United States. Each Crewmember is important to our rapid growth and enduring success. Now is your chance to join the Team and Raise The Bar!

This role involves coordinating lighting equipment, managing a team of lighting technicians, and ensuring all lighting projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards. The Lighting Operations Manager ensures safe and efficient lighting systems setup, deployment, control, and maintenance while adhering to industry standards and client specifications.

**QUALIFICATIONS/ REQUIREMENTS:** The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required to perform the essential functions of this job while exercising appropriate levels of judgment and discretion.

* Crew management
* Equipment management
* Budgeting and expenditures
* Reporting and documentation
* Lighting design software
* Project management
* Team leadership
* Cross-departmental collaboration
* Safety compliance
* Flexible schedule and travel

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in Technical Theater (or equivalent work experience)
* 5+ years of experience managing lighting inventory
* 5+ years of supporting event productions
* Experience as a manager is a plus
* Experience creating event layouts in Vectorworks a plus

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Leadership and crew management
* Problem-solving and troubleshooting
* Budget management and cost control
* Technical knowledge of lighting systems
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* Attention to detail and safety-conscious

jobs.title: Maintenance & Property Operations Coordinator - Property Management
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Maintenance & Property Operations Coordinator is responsible for coordinating property maintenance, vendor services, inspections, unit turnovers, and other day to day property operations. This role requires strong organization, responsive communication, sound judgment, attention to detail, and consistent ownership of assignments from initiation through completion.

About the Role

Do you enjoy a dynamic working environment and using a variety of skills throughout the day? Our growing real estate firm is looking for a team member who can provide excellent, personal service to tenants, prospective tenants, property owners, vendors, and contractors.

We are seeking an experienced professional with a proven track record, but are also open to motivated candidates who are eager to learn and grow. Friendly, reliable, and professional personalities are a must. We value people who work hard, communicate well, take ownership of their responsibilities, and act with integrity in serving our clients.

Maintenance Coordination

· Handle maintenance coordination and administrative tasks, including work orders, service requests, property maintenance, unit turnovers, and vendor compliance requirements.

· Respond promptly to tenant maintenance needs and assist in meeting property and lease obligations.

· Answer, triage, and initiate phone calls, emails, and texts relating to maintenance issues with tenants, owners and vendors.

· Create and manage maintenance work orders from emails, texts, phone calls, inspections, and other sources.

· Troubleshoot maintenance issues with tenants when appropriate to help determine the nature and urgency of the problem.

· Schedule and coordinate vendors and maintenance technicians with occupants and tenants.

· Obtain quotes as required under company and property guidelines and communicate with owners for approval when necessary.

· Follow up with contractors and vendors to ensure work is progressing and completed in a timely manner.

· Keep work orders current in property management software with accurate notes, assignments, status updates, next steps, and resolutions.

· Support field technicians by locating and ordering parts or services as needed.

· Review contractor invoices to confirm work has been completed and charges are consistent with approved work; submit approved invoices to accounting.

· Maintain warranty information and preventive maintenance schedules as appropriate.

· Develop and maintain strong relationships with tenants, vendors, contractors, and service providers.

· Maintain vendor records and required documentation, including insurance coverage, tax identification information, and W-9s.

· Proactively identify and evaluate new vendors to support service quality, responsiveness, and cost efficiency.

· Document troubleshooting steps, repair findings, and maintenance research for future reference and process improvement.

· Provide on-site access to vendors and oversee entry for maintenance and repair work when required.

· Keep owners informed of significant property maintenance issues and obtain approval for work when appropriate.

· Coordinate move-in dates with tenants, property managers, maintenance personnel, vendors, and other team members.

· Manage the transition between move-out, property repairs, cleaning, inspections, leasing, and move-in.

· Confirm the property is ready for occupancy prior to the scheduled move-in.

· Coordinate delivery of keys, remotes, access devices, parking information, building access instructions, and other property-specific items.

· Ensure required move-in documentation has been completed before possession is provided.

· Provide new tenants with company contact information, maintenance reporting procedures, rent payment instructions, and other important tenancy information.

· Enter and maintain accurate tenant, lease, unit, and property information in property management software and other company systems.

· Coordinate completion and documentation of move-in inspections as required.

Property Operations Coordination

· Review move-in, move-out, maintenance, periodic, and tenant assessment inspections and create maintenance requests for identified issues.

· At move-out, compare the tenant move-in inspection with the move-out inspection to help identify potential security deposit deductions and owner maintenance charges.

· Create necessary maintenance requests from inspection findings, assign them to appropriate vendors, and manage them through completion.

· Coordinate inspection-related maintenance with leasing and turnover deadlines.

· Create, update, and maintain rental listings and property advertisements on approved leasing platforms.

· Review active rental advertisements regularly for accuracy, including rent, deposits, availability dates, property features, photos, and other leasing information.

· Maintain knowledge of available and upcoming rental inventory.

· Coordinate closely with property management and maintenance regarding property readiness, anticipated availability dates, repairs, cleaning, inspections, and unit turnovers.

· Review applications for completeness and obtain missing information or documentation from applicants while adhering to company procedures and applicable Fair Housing requirements.

· Communicate application status and requests for additional documentation to applicants and appropriate team members in a timely and professional manner.

· Prepare complete application packages and supporting information for review and approval when required.

· Prepare residential lease agreements, addenda, disclosures, and related leasing documents using company-approved forms and procedures.

· Confirm that rent, security deposit, occupants, pets, utilities, parking, dates, and other property-specific terms are accurately reflected in leasing documents.

· Confirm required move-in funds, proof of insurance, utility confirmations, and other required docu

jobs.description:
**Build Your Future. Build the Skyline. Build with Enclos.**

At Enclos, we bring some of the world's most iconic buildings to life through innovative facade design, engineering, fabrication, and installation. From landmark stadiums to architectural masterpieces, our teams take on complex challenges that shape the skylines of tomorrow.

We're looking for a Project Manager to support our growing project portfolio in the San Francisco Bay Area. This role is ideal for a construction professional with curtainwall experience who is ready to take ownership of key project activities, collaborate across engineering, manufacturing, vendors, and field operations, and continue developing their project management expertise.

You'll play an important role in keeping projects organized, on schedule, within budget, and aligned with Enclos's quality and safety standards while working alongside experienced project leaders.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

Manages total construction effort to ensure project is constructed in accordance with design, budget, and schedule. May supervise and coordinate various sub-contractors to ensure their contracts are complied with or may supervise and coordinate trades.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Project Management & Coordination**

* Support project planning, set up, and execution from design development through installation and closeout.
* Develop and maintain project logs, documentation, submittal schedules, and tracking tools to support project milestones.
* Coordinate shop drawings, engineering submittals, samples, mock-ups, and fabrication releases.
* Monitor project schedules, understand critical activities and dependencies, and help identify potential delays and coordination issues.
* Maintain project records and communicate updates, outstanding items, and required actions to internal teams and external partners.

**Procurement & Vendor Management**

* Prepare requests for proposals and coordinate procurement activities for assigned vendors and subcontractors.
* Support vendor selection, purchase orders, pricing updates, and subcontract documentation.
* Coordinate with vendors, internal manufacturing facilities, and field teams to support material availability and project sequencing.
* Track vendor commitments, deliverables, and documentation to help maintain project schedules and cost controls.

**Cost Management & Documentation**

* Support monthly billing through invoice review, approval coordination, and collection of required waivers and supporting documentation.
* Maintain project control logs for assigned vendors and subcontractors.
* Review project changes, document scope impacts, and obtain revised vendor pricing to support change orders and back-charges.
* Assist with subcontract agreements, contract documentation, and organization of project legal and risk management records.

**Field Operations & Quality**

* Coordinate material deliveries, site logistics, and vendor activities with field personnel and project teams.
* Work with field teams to ensure materials, equipment, and supplies available when needed.
* Assist with labor tracking and audit field-entered data for accuracy.
* Support field quality assurance and quality control activities, including punch list management.
* Coordinate field water testing with testing agencies, general contractors, and field personnel, and collect and submit test reports.
* Participate in jobsite safety walks, model safe work practices, and promote a strong safety culture.
* Help identify field conditions, predecessor activities, and outstanding items that could affect installation progress.

**Teamwork & Continuous Development**

* Collaborate with engineering, design, fabrication, manufacturing, vendors, general contractors, and field teams to resolve project challenges.
* Communicate clearly and proactively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Build technical knowledge of curtainwall systems, construction processes, project controls, and risk management.
* Share knowledge with developing team members and provide guidance to Assistant Project Managers and Project Coordinators as appropriate.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management or a related field, with 3-5 years of related curtainwall construction experience and/or training; an equivalent combination of education and experience will also be considered.
* Working knowledge of curtainwall construction, including blueprint reading, metals, glass, design, engineering, fabrication, curtainwall systems, and field installation procedures.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, project specifications, schedules, and contract documents.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities, follow through on commitments, and meet deadlines with accuracy.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to coordinate with vendors, subcontractors, clients, and internal teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel; familiarity with project management, job costing, billing, and labor management software is beneficial.
* Experience with Microsoft Project or other project scheduling software is preferred.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to apply mathematical concepts to practical construction and project management situations.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively by air and automobile to support projects.

**Compensation**

At the Enclos family of companies, compensation is determined based on several factors including but not limited to work experience, education, geographic location, certifications, etc. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation package for your preferred role during the hiring process. The successful candidate for the Project Manager role in San Francisco, CA can expect to earn $120,000 to $160,000 per year. This position is also eligible to participate in the company's incentive bonus plan.

Benefits

jobs.title: Project Manager, Field Service, Applied Intelligence
jobs.description:
Applied Intelligence is the bridge between Rivian's field operations and its digital technology teams. AI is redefining what a service operation can be, and the opportunity belongs to people who can live in both worlds at once — deep enough in the field to know how the work actually gets done, current enough with frontier AI to know what just became possible. Most roles are built for one world or the other; this team is built for both. We study the latest models, techniques, and architectures; we run time studies beside advisors and technicians; we analyze operational data at scale; and we turn what we learn into AI-native products and workflows that give the operation leverage it didn't have last quarter.

We build before we hand off. Prototypes are functional, simulators stand in for the operation, and every workflow carries an eval and regression suite that proves it behaves — in shadow first, never on a customer. We are AI-first in our own work too: our admin, analysis, and project management run through the same class of tools we ask the field to trust. And we hold one constraint above the rest: everything we ship must be grounded in the measured reality of the operation — quality, performance, customer satisfaction — and must make service feel more human, not less. We automate the burdens so the people stay in the hospitality.

**This Is What You’ll Do**

* **Know the operation — firsthand and at scale.** Spend real time with advisors, technicians, readiness specialists, and leaders; run time studies that quantify where the hours actually go. Pair that with service, capacity, and customer-satisfaction data at scale, so every proposal is grounded in the measured reality of quality, performance, and the customer's experience.
* **Do real research at the frontier.** Track new models, techniques, architectures, and best practices as a working discipline. Evaluate what each unlocks against real service workflows — what is buildable this quarter that wasn't last quarter — and bring back conclusions, not links.
* **Build working prototypes — and prove them.** Build products, agentic workflows, and dashboards in AI-native development environments; build the simulators that exercise them; and write the eval and regression suites that hold non-deterministic systems to a standard. You hold your own quality gate.
* **Hand off cleanly to partner teams.** Translate validated workflows into what Digital Technology and AI Engineering need to build at scale: decision points, eval criteria, human-in-the-loop tiers, and the success metrics that hold in production. The handoff is where your work meets theirs; we obsess over it.
* **Run your own work AI-first.** Your admin, analysis, and project management run through the same class of tools you ask the field to trust. Your daily workflow is the demo.

**This Is What You’ll Need**

We hire for evidence of capability, not credentials. No degree requirement at any level — not required, not preferred, not "or equivalent." A degree is welcome; its absence is not a signal. What we require instead, in any one of three forms (or a combination).

* **Applied ingenuity.** Concrete artifacts you built, shipped, or stood up — tools, systems, processes, decisions. Real, named, traceable to your own contribution. Bonus when it happened despite organizational drag, not because of it.
* **Sequential growth in demanding, execution-driven organizations.** Increasing scope — IC to lead, lead to lead-of-leads, single project to program — in organizations where the standard is set by your colleagues, not the brand. The signal is the bar your peers held you to, not the logo on your resume.
* **A personal portfolio.** Public work, side projects, writing, open-source, agentic systems built outside work — anything that shows you ship and think in the open. For early-career candidates, it can substitute entirely for organizational pedigree.
* HS diploma or equivalent is required.

**This Is Who You Are**

  

* A strategic communicator at every level of the audience. With the field team, you are concrete and operational. With executives, you frame strategic choices, business outcomes, and investment sequencing. The point of view is always present; the clarity runs through both.
* A researcher and an operator in the same week. You read the model release on Monday and run the time study on Wednesday. You don't translate between technical and operational; you work in both — and you take notes from a senior advisor like they are the senior expert in the room, because they are.
* A hands-on builder who proves before specifying. You build the prototype, the simulator, and the eval suite before you ask anyone else to commit — and you use AI on yourself first. Show the system working, then hand it off.
* Clear that service stays human. You are building a world-class service experience on a modern technology stack. You automate burdens so people have more room to take care of the customer, never the reverse.
* Focused on outcomes, not updates. You measure your output in working, tested prototypes and validated workflows. Cadences and status reports exist to serve the work, never the other way around.

jobs.title: Data Program Manager, Science
jobs.description:
Human Data - San Francisco

**About the Team**  
OpenAI’s Research Data team exists to accelerate the evaluation, safety and capabilities of our models and products. Made up of technical operators and software engineers, we design the methods through which we acquire and create data.

**About the Role**  
As a Data Program Manager, Science, you will help researchers develop and execute scientific data programs, connecting OpenAI’s research priorities with relevant data, expertise and external partners.

You’ll work closely with researchers to understand their needs, assess the scientific and practical value of opportunities, and develop partnerships across the scientific ecosystem. The work could range from acquiring existing datasets to shaping research collaborations. You’ll carry opportunities from initial investigation through commercial discussions, agreements, delivery and research use, exercising sound judgement around sensitive data and relationships.

Our current work focuses particularly on biology and chemistry. We welcome different combinations of scientific, technical and partnership experience.

This role is based in our San Francisco HQ.

**In this role, you will:**

* **Develop data strategies with Research.** Translate research goals, model limitations and evaluation gaps into evidence needs and success criteria. Compare acquisition with internal, public and commissioned alternatives.
* **Find distinctive sources for research.** Build trusted local and international relationships across research and industry, including organisations at the scientific frontier.
* **Assess opportunities in scientific context.** Inspect samples for provenance, context, quality and completeness. Assess usefulness, involving researchers and specialists as needed.
* **Shape partnerships with lasting scientific value.** Understand partners’ ambitions and define pilots, deliverables and acceptance criteria, considering expertise, scientific contribution and continuing relationships alongside commercial terms.
* **Lead commercial and operational execution.** Develop proposals, assess pricing and negotiate terms. Coordinate Legal, Privacy, Security, Procurement and engineering to clarify permissions, responsibilities and delivery.
* **Navigate sensitive collaborations.** Understand institutional interests and confidentiality. Identify ethical, privacy, security and misuse concerns early, involving specialists to develop responsible arrangements.
* **Follow through into research use.** Coordinate preparation whether to expand, change or stop.
* **Make thoughtful portfolio decisions.** Recommend options based on research value, cost, timing and capacity. Identify shared needs and opportunities for useful collaboration across projects.
* **Make the work more repeatable.** Use code, APIs, automation and AI tools to improve sourcing, assessment and delivery. Resolve recurring blockers with engineers and retain partner knowledge and research feedback.

**You might thrive in this role if you:**

* Have substantial grounding in biology, chemistry or related sciences through research, industry or equivalent experience, and engage critically with methods and evidence.
* Have delivered complex scientific, data or partnership projects, with depth in one or more of scientific data and evaluation, commercial partnerships or research collaborations across organisations.
* Exercise sound judgement: test claims, match evidence to research needs and make clear recommendations while acknowledging uncertainty.
* Work directly with data: inspect unfamiliar files, investigate quality and use Python, SQL, APIs and AI-assisted coding to answer questions and reduce manual work.
* Build trust through careful listening, precise questions and thoughtful negotiation. You bring relevant local and international relationships, or a demonstrated ability to develop them, and understand what partners value beyond the transaction.
* Exercise discretion, recognising the limits of your expertise and authority and when scientific, ethical or safety questions need specialist input.
* Thrive in a fast-moving environment, taking broad ownership across multiple projects and moving readily between scientific, technical and commercial questions. You prioritise thoughtfully as needs change, making clear decisions about where to focus and what can wait.
* Enjoy getting your hands dirty, bringing energy and creative problem solving to unfamiliar or ambiguous opportunities. You turn them into practical plans and follow through on the details.
* Learn exceptionally quickly, developing your understanding of AI training, evaluation and unfamiliar research areas to become a useful collaborator.
* We welcome different combinations of scientific, technical and partnership experience. You do not need equal depth in every area.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**

* Own execution of the BU's manufacturing ramps across Fremont and Ipoh; translate business ramp targets and required wafer starts into the manufacturing-readiness actions needed to deliver output at both sites.
* Determine the full set of requirements for each ramp—equipment capacity and installation timing, operator and engineering resourcing, process readiness, process and equipment qualification, facility readiness, critical materials and consumables, substrates, tooling, and backend capacity—and drive each element to readiness ahead of required wafer starts and production volumes.
* Own and maintain the integrated readiness schedule linking Fremont's 3-inch fab ramp (high-power CW lasers, high-speed photodiodes) to Ipoh bar fabrication, coating, qualification, assembly, and backend, ensuring downstream capability is ready as Fremont output increases.
* Own and maintain the capacity model for the Fremont fab and the site—covering tool capacity, utilization, uptime, cycle time, yield, and staffing assumptions—and keep it current with demand, wafer-start plans, and equipment changes to identify bottlenecks early and support capacity investment and ramp decisions.
* Identify gaps between required capacity and actual readiness; drive cross-functional actions with Fremont and Ipoh factory teams, engineering, procurement, and suppliers to close them.
* Manage weekly ramp targets and shipment targets at Ipoh; track output against plan, identify shortfalls, and drive the factory recovery actions needed to meet the BU's delivery commitments.
* Drive equipment delivery, installation, and qualification against ramp timing; manage supplier lead times, expedites, and pull-ins to protect the ramp schedule.
* Manage critical consumables and constrained materials against the ramp to prevent material-driven shortfalls at either site.
* Ensure people and processes are ready ahead of volume—operator staffing and training, process qualification, and work-instruction readiness.
* Drive systems readiness ahead of volume in partnership with IT, engineering, and product data teams—ensure part numbers, BOMs, and routings are created and released in PLM (e.g., Agile) and ERP; MES process flows, operations, and data collection are configured (e.g., CAMSTAR); and labels, lot traceability, and shipping documentation are set up and validated at Fremont, Ipoh, and partner sites, so material can be started, tracked, and shipped without system-driven delays.
* Lead full manufacturing-chain readiness for major ramps, including the NVIDIA 400mW CoC program for co-packaged optics, ensuring the chain is ready at the volume and timing required by the business.
* Run weekly cross-site execution reviews; report ramp status, risks, and recovery plans to operations and BU leadership, and drive corrective actions to closure.
* Generate program schedules and risk-mitigation plans for key ramps; drive milestone agreements and key decisions across engineering, operations, procurement, and factory teams.
* Escalate constraints with clear, data-backed mitigation options, acting as the single owner accountable for ramp readiness across the manufacturing chain.

**Education & Experience**

* Minimum 5-7 years of relevant experience in semiconductor or photonics manufacturing operations, with a focus on capacity ramp, operations program management, or industrialization—preferably in a wafer fabrication environment.
* Minimum 3-5 years leading cross-site and/or contract-manufacturing ramps spanning assembly and fabrication.
* Demonstrated ownership of equipment installation and qualification, capacity planning, and manufacturing-readiness execution for new-product or volume ramps.
* BS degree in engineering or a relevant technical field required.
* MS degree in engineering, industrial engineering, operations/supply chain, or business preferred.

jobs.title: Creator & Community Program Lead — Grok Imagine
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

The Imagine Product team is redefining AI-driven media experiences for Grok users worldwide. In this role, you'll build the communications system that meets creators where they are: public proof of what Grok Imagine can do, programs that show creators how it makes them faster, more cost-efficient, or more ambitious, and a community that runs from individual makers to production houses. The job is to move the brand from talking about itself to making other people talk about it — through proof, craft, and community. If you're a hands-on communicator who can turn product capability into credible stories, repeat advocates, and a feedback loop back into the product, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own creator and community communications strategy for Grok Imagine — plan and execute outreach that turns product capability into visible proof, creator adoption, and durable brand affinity.
* Build and ship product-showcase content across owned channels.
* Design and run influencer programs as two distinct motions: awareness partners who put Grok Imagine in front of volume, and craft partners.
* Build relationships with production houses, studios, and in-house creative teams. Get Grok Imagine into real editorial and post-production pipelines, and run a two-way channel so professional workflow feedback reaches the product.
* Manage external production when in-house capacity is not enough — bidding, contracts, workflow, and quality control — in close partnership with creative leads who set the taste bar for anything that ships under Grok's name.
* Track how competing AI media products talk to creators and professionals. Build the measurement that shows which communications work actually drives adoption, and that can support investment in the work.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Proven experience leading communications, creator partnerships, or community programs for a consumer or creator-facing product, including shipped showcases, tutorials, case studies, or creator programs that moved people from curiosity to practice.
* Hands-on operator: you can write a brief, run outreach, ship a content calendar, manage a vendor, and stand up a curation and rights-clearance pipeline without a large team underneath you.
* Experience working with creators, influencers, or professional media practitioners, and judgment about which voices confer reach versus which confer credibility.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; you can be precise with internal partners and compelling with external audiences.
* Strong editorial judgment and a clear standard for what can go out under the brand.
* Comfort operating in a small, high-velocity team alongside product, research, design, and engineering.

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Background in AI-driven media, generative tools, or adjacent creative software.
* Experience running both broad-reach influencer programs and credibility-building partnerships with working professionals.
* Familiarity with production, post-production, or studio workflows — and how new tools actually enter them.
* Experience managing agencies or production vendors end to end.
* Analytics-informed content practice: using performance data to set cadence, format mix, and spend.
* Demonstrated taste in visual and motion media, and a point of view on what makes generative work look professional rather than novel.
* Prior work moving a product's public perception from novelty to working tool.

### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**

$140,000 - $196,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

jobs.title: Behavioral Health Program Manager, IBH
jobs.description:
*The Supervisor for Integrated Behavioral Health Services provides operational leadership and frontline*

*management for integrated behavioral health clinicians embedded within pediatric medical specialty*

*services at UCSF Benioff Children's Hospitals. This position is responsible for the daily operations,*

*workforce management, quality oversight, and program implementation supporting behavioral health*

*services across inpatient and outpatient pediatric specialty programs, including Hematology/Oncology and*

*other pediatric medical subspecialties.*

*Working in a highly matrixed environment, the supervisor partners with physician, nursing, operational, and*

*administrative leaders to ensure behavioral health services are seamlessly integrated into interdisciplinary*

*care delivery. The supervisor promotes excellence in patient- and family-centered care, advances equitable*

*access to behavioral health services, and supports strategic initiatives that improve clinical outcomes,*

*patient experience, workforce engagement, and operational performance.*

*The supervisor creates an environment that supports collaboration, continuous learning, innovation, diversity,*

*equity, inclusion, and belonging while fostering professional growth among behavioral health clinicians.*

**DEPARTMENT DESCRIPTION:**

Integrated Behavioral Health (IBH) Services are part of the Child and Adolescent Mental Health Service

Line at UCSF Benioff Children's Hospitals. The Child and Adolescent Mental Health Service Line brings

together inpatient, outpatient, consultation-liaison, and integrated behavioral health programs to create a

coordinated system of care that expands access, improves clinical outcomes, and advances the mental

health and well-being of children, adolescents, and families across UCSF Benioff Children's Hospitals.

  

The IBH programs partner with pediatric medical and surgical specialty programs to provide integrated,

family-centered behavioral health care for children, adolescents, and young adults with acute and chronic

medical conditions.

  

Mental health clinicians are embedded within inpatient and outpatient specialty services—including Primary

Care and medical specialties—to address the psychological, emotional, developmental, and behavioral

needs of patients and families throughout the continuum of care. Working collaboratively with physicians,

nurses, social workers, child life specialists, rehabilitation providers, and other interdisciplinary team

members, the IBH program promotes early identification and intervention, improves access to behavioral

health services, strengthens care coordination, and supports positive health outcomes.

  

**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:**

* Master's or doctoral degree in Psychology, Social Work, Marriage and Family Therapy, Counseling, or related behavioral health discipline.
* Current California licensure appropriate to discipline (Psychologist, LCSW, LMFT, LPCC, or equivalent).
* Demonstrated knowledge of integrated behavioral health models in inpatient and ambulatory care.
* Demonstrated supervisory skills to guide behavioral health providers on treatment methods for serious mental health disorders.
* Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and execute plans to meet deadlines.
* Organizational skills for coordinating staff schedules and unit operations.
* Ability to ensure patient care service standards are consistently met; assist staff with managing challenging patient interactions with sensitivity and skill.
* Experience providing a range of behavioral health services, including individual, family, crisis and brief therapy, behavioral health screening, crisis intervention, consultation, and care coordination.
* Experience providing evidence-based behavioral health assessment, diagnosis, and treatment in pediatric, medical, behavioral health, or integrated care settings.
* *At least two (2) years post-licensure clinical experience.*

**PREFERRED:**

* Knowledge of medical center, HR and UC policies and processes. Knowledge of relevant psychiatric health services internal policies and external regulations.
* Working knowledge of human resources management practices and policies.
* Knowledge of business software, specialized applications and EHR systems used in behavioral health clinics / clinical departments.
* Ability to perform all commonly applicable functions in word processing and spreadsheet software.
* Comprehensive knowledge of organization's patient record system to teach others.
  

**LICENSES AND/OR CERTIFICATIONS:**

* Current California licensure appropriate to discipline (Psychologist, LCSW, LMFT, LPCC, or

  equivalent).

jobs.title: Customer Experience Manager
jobs.description:
**Customer Experience Manager – San Jose, CA (95128)**
======================================================

**Salary:** $75,000 – $85,000 annually | **Location:** San Jose, CA 95128

**Quick Facts:** Full-Time • Leadership Role • Office Operations  
Team Development • Customer Experience • Growth-Focused

**Lead the team responsible for every family’s first and lasting impression.**

The **Customer Experience Manager** oversees all front-office operations and is responsible for delivering a consistent, high-quality experience for families. This role plays a key part in operational execution, customer retention, and team performance.

This is a **hands-on leadership position** requiring strong people-management skills, sound judgment, and the ability to balance service standards with business needs. **Weekend availability is required.**

**About Waterworks Aquatics**
-----------------------------

Waterworks Aquatics is a **premier swim school** teaching children (ages 3 months and up) and adults how to swim. Our mission is to **educate and motivate individuals to be safer and learn proper swimming technique.** Every role in our organization supports that mission through professionalism, consistency, and care.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**
-----------------------------

* Lead, coach, and develop Customer Experience Experts, Senior Customer Experience Experts, Shift Leads, and Deck Hosts.
* Set and reinforce service standards, daily responsibilities, and performance expectations.
* Oversee front-office operations to ensure alignment with company policies and procedures.
* Support enrollment, retention, and revenue initiatives, including private lessons and package optimization.
* Ensure a professional, customer-focused experience across all in-person and phone interactions.
* Monitor staffing levels and recommend coverage adjustments as needed.
* Oversee onboarding, training completion, and ongoing development of office staff.
* Partner with Customer Relations and regional leadership on escalated concerns.
* Maintain facility readiness, inventory oversight, and operational standards.
* Address employee performance through coaching, feedback, and corrective action when necessary.

**Our Core Values**
-------------------

* **Passion** — you care deeply about the experience families and team members have.
* **Adaptability** — you adjust priorities and leadership approach as needs evolve.
* **Self-Responsibility** — you take ownership of outcomes, decisions, and performance.
* **Approachability** — you communicate clearly and foster trust through accessibility and professionalism.
* **Integrity** — you do what’s right, even when navigating complex or sensitive situations.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

* 3–5 years of direct people-management experience.
* 3–5 years of customer service experience in a high-volume environment.
* Strong communication, organization, and follow-through skills.
* Ability to manage priorities and lead teams effectively.
* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* CPR, AED, and First Aid certification (required or ability to obtain).
* Availability to work full-time hours, including at least one weekend day.

**Ready to lead with purpose?** Apply today and help shape the experience families trust.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:** Waterworks Aquatics provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other protected status under applicable law. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility upon hire.

Provides overall leadership to the Store Support team. Responsible for all aspects of daily operations including cash management, expense control, buying, merchandising, labor, regulatory compliance, and special projects as assigned. * Defines and develops clear expectations to achieve the highest standards of retail execution. performance and minimizes turnover.
* Makes hiring and separation decisions in partnership with Store Leadership.
* Ensures an effective and efficient response to customer questions, requests, and/or concerns.
* Maintains Team Member safety and security standards.
* Establishes and maintains collaborative and productive relationships with departmental and store leadership.
* Communicates objectives and relevant information clearly to Team Members.
* Establishes and maintains positive and productive vendor relationships.
* Ensures compliance with relevant regulatory rules and standards.
* Sustains exceptional level of knowledge / awareness of relevant competitors and industry trends.

* Consistently communicates and models WFM vision and goals.

* Advanced knowledge of products, buying, pricing, merchandising, and inventory management.
* Excellent interpersonal, motivational, team building, and customer relationship skills.
* Capable of teaching others in a positive and constructive manner.
* Product knowledge.
* Advanced knowledge of regulatory and safety policies and procedures.
