jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Office Manager
jobs.description:
Amber Semiconductor is a fast-moving team building power delivery technology for AI datacenter hardware.

We're looking for an Executive Assistant & Office Manager to be the person who keeps our office running smoothly and our leaders focused on their work. You'll be the first face visitors see and the person the team relies on for anything around the office as well as a pillar of organization amongst the executive team. This is a hands-on, in-person role that suits someone who is detail-oriented, has great communication skills, and can manage shifting priorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Executive Assistance**

* Manage calendars and schedule meetings for executives, including coordinating across US and Asia time zones, internal teams, and external parties
* Communicate directly with internal and external contacts on behalf of executives to schedule, confirm, and follow up
* Book and manage business travel, including flights, hotels, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries, and handle changes when plans shift
* Plan and coordinate company events and offsites, such as team gatherings, customer visits, and trade show logistics, from early planning through execution
* Prepare expense reports and help executives stay on top of deadlines and commitments
* Handle confidential information with discretion

**Office Management**

* Greet and manage visitors, including guests, candidates, customers, and partners, and handle badging, check-in, and conference room setup
* Keep the office clean, organized, and welcoming, and coordinate with building management, cleaning services, and facilities vendors on repairs and maintenance
* Keep the kitchen, break areas, and supply cabinet stocked, and manage ordering and vendor relationships for snacks, beverages, office supplies, and equipment
* Receive, sort, and distribute incoming mail and packages, and handle outgoing mail and shipments
* Onboard new hires on the office side (desk setup, access, supplies, welcome logistics)
* Support HR administration, including new-hire paperwork, benefits enrollment with our PEO, and employee records
* Support office safety and compliance, including emergency contacts, first aid supplies, and basic safety procedures
* Track office expenses and supply budgets, and help process employee expense reports and reimbursements

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in an office management, executive assistant, or similar administrative role, ideally at a startup or small company
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and personable manner
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to juggle competing priorities without dropping details
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, and Excel with comfort learning new software
* Experience booking and managing complex travel
* Sound judgment and discretion with sensitive information
* Ability to work on-site every day and occasionally lift supplies or packages (up to ~25 lbs)

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in a technology, semiconductor, or hardware company
* Experience in Human Resource roles

jobs.title: Human Data - Business Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.  
  
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

Human Data powers model training and evaluation by producing high-quality human-generated data at scale. This role focuses on the metrics, systems, and operating insights that help Human Data run efficiently—spanning workforce performance, capacity and allocation, operational process health, and decision-making support for cross-functional partners. Our ideal candidate is a proactive analyst with strong quantitative skills and operational judgment, able to turn incomplete data into clear recommendations that improve throughput, quality, cost, and reliability. You will partner with operations leaders, engineering stakeholders, and enabling teams to identify problems, build operating systems, and drive improved planning decisions.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Perform analyses of Human Data operational metrics—such as capacity, utilization, quality, throughput, cycle time, cost efficiency, and workforce health—to uncover trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Build and maintain reporting, trackers, and dashboards that make core operating KPIs visible and actionable for managers and cross-functional partners.
* Develop and improve planning and forecasting views (e.g., demand signals, supply/capacity, staffing needs, or process volumes) that support proactive, informed decisions.
* Support allocation and operating tradeoffs by synthesizing operational and performance data into clear recommendations for who/what should move where.
* Design, document, and refine operational processes and escalation paths so recurring work - performance actions, staffing, handoffs, and similar flows - is consistent, measurable, and scalable.
* Identify data gaps and partner with stakeholders to improve data collection, hygiene, and definitions so analysis and operating systems remain reliable.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, engineering, recruiting, onboarding, finance, and other partners to integrate insights into hiring, staffing, performance management, and operational planning decisions.
* Deliver concise readouts and recommendations to stakeholders, translating analysis into business-oriented next steps and tradeoffs.
* Own ad-hoc research and special projects that improve Human Data operating leverage.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree
* 1+ years of professional experience in business analytics, business operations, consulting, workforce/operations analysis, or growth/ops strategy
* 1+ years of experience building and owning analytical models, trackers, or operating systems in Excel / Google Sheets or equivalent

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field
* Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimization
* Experience with forecasting, capacity planning, workforce analytics, or performance metrics
* Proficiency in statistical or analytical techniques (e.g., cohort analysis, regression, time-series, anomaly detection) in Python, R, or similar
* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI) or modern BI workflows
* Background in high-growth tech, marketplace/staffing operations, data labeling, human-in-the-loop systems, or consulting environments
* Excellent communication skills, with a track record of presenting insights to non-technical audiences and influencing cross-functional teams
* Project management experience, including prioritizing work in fast-paced settings and driving process change with diverse stakeholders
* Comfort using modern AI tools to accelerate analysis and operational workflow design

### **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Weekend work may be required.
* Travel to other SpaceXSI sites may be required.

### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**

$122,000 - $180,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

*SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Federal Compass is a leading SaaS provider offering a comprehensive suite of business process automation, pipeline management, and opportunity sourcing tools designed to empower Federal contractors. Our mission is to streamline the complex government contracting lifecycle, enabling our clients to identify, pursue, and win more opportunities. We're a high-growth company with a passionate team dedicated to delivering exceptional value and outcomes for our customers.

**Position Summary:**

The Customer Success Manager is a key member of our Customer Success team, responsible for ensuring that a portfolio of clients successfully adopts, uses, and derives maximum value from our platform. This role requires an **entrepreneurial spirit** and a **proactive approach** to problem-solving. You'll serve as the primary point of contact for clients, guiding them through the entire customer journey from onboarding to renewal. You'll be a trusted advisor, helping Federal contractors optimize their business development processes and achieve their growth goals by tailoring your approach to the diverse **personas** you engage with.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Customer Relationship & Portfolio/Project Management***

* Serve as the primary point of contact for a designated portfolio of clients, building and nurturing strong relationships with both **end-users and key decision-makers**.
* Use data from **HubSpot** and other internal tools to **assess the health of your portfolio** and proactively identify at-risk accounts.
* Tailor your communication and engagement strategy to the specific role and needs of each person you interact with, from the day-to-day user to the executive sponsor.
* Act as a customer advocate, ensuring their feedback and needs are heard by internal teams like Product and Engineering.

***Persona-Driven Onboarding & Product Adoption***

* Lead the onboarding process by first identifying the key **personas** and their specific goals.
* Conduct onboarding sessions tailored to each persona's role—for example, focusing on pipeline tracking with a BD Manager and ticket management with an end-user.
* Focus on maximizing **product adoption** from the outset by actively guiding users to key features that align with their business goals.
* Ensure a swift **time-to-value** by helping new clients achieve their first key business outcome quickly.

***Problem-Solving & Support Tickets***

* Manage and resolve incoming **support tickets** from your clients, ensuring timely and effective solutions.
* Tailor your support and troubleshooting approach based on the user's role and technical proficiency.
* Take a self-motivated, proactive approach to anticipating customer needs and identifying potential issues before they arise.

***Revenue Growth & Retention***

* Manage the renewal process for your portfolio of clients by engaging with the appropriate **decision-makers** to demonstrate the product's value and ROI.
* Identify opportunities for **expansion and upsell**, positioning new features or products that align with the client's evolving needs, especially those of the executive personas.
* Collaborate with the sales and marketing teams to highlight the value of our platform and identify new growth opportunities.

***Time Management & Workflow***

* Independently manage your time to ensure the necessary focus is given to onboarding, customer check-ins, and the timely resolution of support tickets.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records and activities within **HubSpot**.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Gross Retention Rate:** Contribute to the team's gross retention rate by managing client relationships and mitigating churn risk.
* **Net Revenue Retention (NRR) / Net Dollar Retention (NDR):** Contribute to the team's NRR by identifying and driving upsell opportunities.
* **Time to Value:** Ensure new clients in your portfolio achieve their first key business outcome quickly.
* **Customer Health Score:** Maintain a high customer health score for your accounts by ensuring consistent engagement and product usage.
* **Product Adoption:** Drive the adoption of key platform features within your client portfolio.
* **Support Ticket Resolution:** Maintain a high customer satisfaction rating on support tickets and meet defined service-level agreement (SLA) targets for resolution time.

**Qualifications:**

***Experience*****:**

* Minimum of [1-2] years of experience in a customer-facing role such as Customer Success, Account Management, or a related field within a B2B SaaS environment.
* Proven experience working with a complex business solution (e.g., CRM, business process management software).
* Experience using **HubSpot** or a similar CRM platform to manage customer accounts and track activities is required.
* Use of GovWin or other Opportunity platform is a plus, but not a requirement.
* Experience with the Federal contracting industry is a plus, but not a requirement.

***Skills:***

* A strong **entrepreneurial spirit** and a highly **self-motivated**, proactive approach to problem-solving.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage a portfolio of clients and prioritize tasks effectively.
* An empathetic and customer-centric mindset with a passion for helping others succeed.
* Ability to use data and analytics to inform your client strategy.

**What We Offer:**

* $60,000-$80,000 base, additional potential $10,000-$30,000 bonus
* Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits.
* 401(k) plan with company match.
* Generous paid time off and holidays.
* Opportunities for professional development and career growth within the Customer Success team.
* A collaborative, mission-driven, and supportive work environment.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $70,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) match

Our suite of platforms features a market-leading procurement marketplace, an ultra-modern home delivery ecommerce experience, and a next-generation practice management system. More than 25,000 hospitals across all 50 states rely on Vetcove daily, supporting tens of thousands of veterinarians who care for tens of millions of pets each year.

We are modernizing the 50 billion dollar plus animal health industry by giving veterinary organizations the tools to focus more on patient care. Backed by Y Combinator and top venture investors in Silicon Valley, New York and Miami, Vetcove is a fast-growing, mission-driven company. We are searching for talented and passionate people who want to help shape the future of veterinary care.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Own Vendor Performance Management:** Run the weekly performance cadence across all fulfillment vendors: scorecard reviews, follow-ups, and corrective action plans; and hold partners accountable to SLAs with persistence and professionalism.
* **Manage Partner Relationships:** Serve as the primary relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of fulfillment vendors: own the recurring meeting cadence, lead business reviews, advocate for Vetcove externally, and keep relationships strong through the ups and downs of operational performance.
* **Analyze at Scale:** Interrogate large datasets (SQL, Excel, BI tools) to identify root causes, quantify operational impact, and build the case for process and integration changes. Defend your conclusions with data.
* **Partner with Product & Engineering:** Translate recurring operational failure modes into integration and fulfillment improvements; write clear requirements, drive prioritization, and follow through until fixes ship and the metrics move.
* **Operationalize New Initiatives:** Take run-state ownership of newly launched programs: build the SOPs, own the KPIs, and make the operational decisions that keep them healthy at scale.
* **Build Operational Rigor:** Author and maintain SOPs, escalation paths, and process documentation that make our vendor operations consistent, auditable, and scalable as the platform grows.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5-8 years of experience in operations, program management, marketplace/ecommerce operations, or supply chain – ideally in roles where you were accountable for external partner performance.

* Strong analytical skills: proficiency in SQL (or demonstrated equivalent), advanced Excel/Sheets, and comfort drawing defensible conclusions from large, messy datasets.
* Exceptional attention to detail: you notice the mismatched count, the silent data gap, the SLA miss buried in an average.
* Experience managing vendor or partner relationships end to end; serving as a partner’s main point of contact, and balancing relationship-building with direct, constructive accountability conversations.
* Excellent written communication and the ability to work cross-functionally with product and engineering teams.
* Self-directed and highly organized in a fully remote environment.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in ecommerce fulfillment, 3PL, pharmacy, or distribution operations.
* Familiarity with BI/analytics tools (e.g., Hex, Looker, Tableau) and building or maintaining operational dashboards.
* Background in animal health, healthcare, or another regulated fulfillment category.

**Benefits (Full Time Roles)**
------------------------------

* 100% remote within the USA
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Automatic 401k contribution
* Employee referral program
* At home office set up
* Bi-annual company retreats
* Open vacation policy
* Equity
* Monthly team events

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
At MSS Pay, we know that getting started with a new payment system can feel overwhelming for a business owner. There are accounts to set up, equipment to configure, questions to answer, and details that need to be handled before everything is ready to go.

That's where our Implementation Manager comes in.

We're looking for someone who's organized, easy to work with, and genuinely enjoys helping people. You'll guide new merchants through the setup process, keep everyone on the same page, and make sure customers feel supported from the beginning.

You don't need to have every answer right away, but you should be someone who follows through, communicates clearly, and knows how to bring the right people together to get things done.

What you'll manage

* Oversee the implementation of payment-processing solutions for new merchant accounts.
* Coordinate merchant onboarding, account setup, and system configuration.
* Work with sales, support, and technical teams to plan implementation timelines.
* Help coordinate point-of-sale equipment setup, payment terminals, and e-commerce integrations.
* Track implementation milestones and resolve delays.
* Communicate with merchants about requirements, timelines, and next steps.
* Coordinate testing and confirm that payment systems are functioning as expected.
* Help troubleshoot implementation issues and escalate technical problems when needed.
* Maintain accurate implementation records and project updates.
* Support merchant training and the transition to ongoing account support.
* Monitor implementation performance and identify opportunities to improve the process.
* Help develop consistent procedures for new merchant launches.

What we're looking for

We're interested in candidates with **3+ years of experience** in implementation management, project management, payment processing, financial technology, SaaS onboarding, banking operations, or a related field.

Experience with merchant services, point-of-sale systems, or payment integrations is preferred but not required.

You should be comfortable managing multiple projects, communicating with clients, coordinating across departments, and working through technical or operational issues.

Experience with CRM platforms, project management tools, payment systems, or software implementations is helpful.

A bachelor's degree in business, information systems, finance, technology, or a related field is preferred, but equivalent professional experience will be considered.

What success looks like

New merchants know what to expect. Systems are configured and tested properly. Problems are addressed quickly. And when implementation is complete, the merchant is ready to use their payment solution with confidence.

We're looking for someone who can manage the details without losing sight of the customer's experience.

Pay: $78,000.00 - $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Onboarding Manager
jobs.description:
**Our Opportunity:**

  

We’re seeking an organized, strategic, customer-focused Onboarding Manager to own the onboarding lifecycle for our multifamily real estate partners: Property Management Companies (PMCs), Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs), regional operations leaders, and onsite community teams.

You’ll lead onboarding from start to finish. That covers the post-sales handoff, account configuration, software integrations, onsite staff training, and early adoption across newly launched property portfolios. During rollout you’ll be the operational anchor, making sure each implementation meets technical, operational, and service-level agreement (SLA) standards. You’ll also keep Sales, Client Success, Field Operations, and Product aligned throughout, so every new portfolio sees value fast.

The ideal candidate is an onboarding expert who has run complex, multi-stakeholder rollouts for enterprise clients and knows how to turn new customers into confident users. Strong technical implementation skills are a must, and experience in multifamily real estate is a plus.

This is an individual contributor role with room to grow as the Onboarding function expands. You’ll improve client retention, shorten time-to-value, and speed up the handoff to Client Success, all while refining the process as you go. Along the way, you’ll help build the operational standards and processes that let Onboarding scale.

### **What You'll Do:**

**Onboarding & Implementation**

* Own onboarding for newly contracted properties, regional rollouts, and portfolio acquisitions, from the sales handoff through the first 90 days after launch.
* Build implementation plans, milestone schedules, and kickoff meetings with regional VPs, Asset Managers, and onsite Community Managers.
* Coordinate technical setup, data migration, and integrations with property management systems such as Yardi, RealPage, Entrata, ResMan, and AppFolio.
* Make sure community profiles and property access credentials are set up accurately before go-live.
* Lead virtual and onsite training for Regional Managers, Property Managers, Leasing Consultants, and Maintenance teams.

**Client Experience**

* Serve as the primary contact and escalation point during the 90-day onboarding window, and diagnose and resolve implementation issues quickly.
* Build trust with VPs of Property Operations, Asset Managers, and Regional VPs by tying the platform to the metrics they care about: NOI, occupancy, and resident retention.
* Run implementation reviews and post-launch health checks to drive adoption and catch churn risk early.
* Track SLA compliance, setup turnaround, CSAT, and early adoption, and act on warning signs before they turn into escalations.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Run formal sales-to-onboarding handoffs to confirm scope, custom contract terms, and client expectations.
* Get Field Operations, Logistics, and Support aligned on property readiness ahead of each go-live.
* Bring client feedback, feature requests, and bug escalations to Product and Engineering.
* Keep Salesforce and project tools accurate so leadership has clear portfolio reporting.

**Process Improvement & Enablement**

* Find recurring friction points and turn the fixes into SOPs, playbooks, and launch checklists that help onboarding scale.
* Create client-facing onboarding materials and training guides built around multifamily workflows.
* Lead workflow automation projects in Salesforce, project management tools, and ticketing systems, partnering with Revenue Operations.
* Act as the team’s subject matter expert on onboarding, sharing best practices with Client Success team members.

### **What Success Looks Like:**

In your first year, success means:

* New properties go live on schedule, meet SLAs, and start with strong satisfaction and health scores.
* The playbooks, SOPs, and automations you build are adopted across Client Services.
* You resolve complex, multi-property launch issues on your own and keep internal teams on track through tight timelines.
* Teammates count on you as a go-to resource for onboarding.

### **What You'll Need:**

**Required Qualifications**

* 3–5 years in client onboarding or implementation at a B2B SaaS or tech-enabled services company.
* A track record of leading enterprise or multi-location rollouts from handoff to adoption, including building the playbooks and SOPs behind them.
* Experience coordinating software integrations or data migrations with clients and technical teams.
* Strong organization. You can manage dozens of rollouts at once without letting quality slip, and you use data to spot and fix problems.
* Clear communication, from presenting to executives to explaining complex workflows to non-technical staff.
* Comfort with ambiguity and changing tools, plus hands-on experience with CRM, project management, and support platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Gong, Kustomer).

jobs.title: Project Manager, Community Veterinary Medicine Project
jobs.description:
Description:

Community medicine is an emerging veterinary discipline focused on expanding access to care for animals and the people who love them. It draws on both shelter medicine and private practice and is organized around principles such as spectrum of care, protocolled medicine, and task-shifting. The field is growing quickly, but it has no shared, authoritative body of guidance.

The Community Veterinary Medicine Project is a collaborative, multi-institution project, housed at the SF SPCA. It will be the first comprehensive, freely available resource for the veterinary field. Over 18 months, an Editorial Leadership Council (ELC) of five veterinary leaders, led by SF SPCA CEO, Dr. Jennifer Scarlett, will work with a national cohort of subject matter expert authors to produce four connected resources:

* **Clinical Guidelines** for veterinarians practicing community medicine
* **An Operations Manual** for launching and running community clinics
* **Clinical Decision Tools** designed for use in the exam room
* **A Research Database**, developed with UC Davis

The work follows a formal governance process with conflict-of-interest disclosure, an AI use policy, external peer review, and review by a Strategic Advisory Council.

You'll own day-to-day delivery of the project: the plan, the timeline, the budget tracking, and the pipeline that moves more than two dozen chapters from first draft to publication. You'll always know where things stand and what's at risk, and you'll bring problems to the Executive Sponsor, Dr. Jennifer Scarlett, early, with options.

This role suits someone who enjoys order, notices when something is about to fall through the cracks, and communicates clearly and warmly with senior professionals. Most of the people you'll work with are senior veterinary leaders who don't report to you and are fitting this work around demanding clinical careers. You don't need a veterinary background, but you do need to be comfortable learning a specialized vocabulary and applying written standards consistently.

The workload rises and falls. It peaks around the open call for authors, contributor onboarding, each convening, and final platform assembly. We'll plan schedules together so hours flex to meet those windows.

**Responsibilities**

*Own Project Plan and Timeline*

* Build and maintain the master project plan and timeline across all four deliverables.
* Spot schedule risks early and bring recovery options to the Executive Sponsor.
* Approve routine deadline extensions within agreed limits and escalate larger changes.
* Track spending against the grant budget and prepare progress and budget inputs for funder reports.
* Keep records that meet funder and governance documentation requirements at all times.

*Run the Governance Process*

* Keep the ELC moving: schedule meetings, set agendas, deliver pre-reads, and follow action items through to completion.
* Run the Strategic Advisory Council's two scope reviews, from distributing materials to consolidating feedback.

*Manage the Contributor Lifecycle and the Review Pipeline*

* Run the open call for authors and onboard selected contributors, making sure every conflict-of-interest disclosure, AI use attestation, and contributor agreement is on file before writing begins.
* Partner with the ELC chair to set and hold authors and reviewers to agreed deadlines.
* Log and organize incoming applications by topic for ELC review.
* Send author notifications and onboarding packets.
* Organize author orientation sessions, kickoff calls, and mid-point check-ins, including recordings for those who can't attend live.
* Maintain an accurate contributor roster with contact details, topic assignments, credentials, and affiliations.

*Track Manuscripts Through Review*

* Log each draft on receipt and run a first-pass check against the submission checklist. This covers file naming, required deliverables, figure files, and completed forms.
* Route drafts to the assigned Category Editor, and track feedback and revision deadlines at each governance stage.
* Manage external peer review logistics: send invitations, share materials, track reviewer agreements and deadlines, and collect comments.
* Keep the project tracker (Asana) and shared Google Drive folders current, so anyone can see where every chapter stands.

*Coordinate the In-Person Convenings*

* Plan two 2-3 day convenings (virtual or in-person), managing logistics, participant travel, and budget, and partner with the facilitator who leads the sessions.
* Process travel reimbursements and contributor stipends according to budget and policy.

*Lead Assembly and Launch*

* Compile contributor attribution, credentials, and COI disclosures for publication front matter.
* Manage final platform assembly by tracking files, version control, and outstanding items.
* Coordinate launch communications logistics, including author notifications and distribution of attribution language.

**Reporting Relationships and Contacts**

* Reports to the Senior Executive Assistant to the CEO; Executive Sponsor: CEO

Established in 2008, Brightway is proud to be one of the fastest-growing insurance agency systems in the United States. With over 350 franchises spanning 35+ states and an impressive $1.3 billion in annual premiums, we rank among the nation’s largest privately owned property and casualty insurance distribution companies. -

Brightway is seeking an Agency Acquisitions Project Manager to own end-to-end project management for agency and book acquisitions from Letter of Intent (LOI) through close. jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
Points North is looking for a Senior Program Manager who is excited to support the way a growing, 60-person SaaS company gets its most important work done. This is not a PMO role where you install a methodology and police it. It is a hands-on role at a company that has grown on the strength of good people and good instincts and now needs just enough structure to keep that working as we take on bigger things: major product launches, company-wide initiatives, and a brand-new product experiment that needs an owner.

You will report to the VP of Engineering, but you will serve with the whole company. Product and Engineering, then Sales, Customer Success, Client Support, Implementation, Operations, Managed Services, Finance, Marketing, and People and Culture. You will be evolving program and project governance from close to zero, which means you get to decide what good looks like here, and you get to live with the results.

If you are the kind of person who believes the best process is the one nobody notices because it just works, who has seen heavyweight frameworks slow good teams down and has no interest in importing one, and who is as comfortable owning a product backlog as you are running a cross-functional launch, we want to talk to you.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Enhance lightweight program and project governance for Product and Engineering, and then for the company. Collaboratively structure and then document how work gets proposed, prioritized, tracked, and finished. Build the minimum that gives leaders the visibility and teams the clarity they need, and then defend that minimum against the natural pull toward more.
* Run our largest cross-functional initiatives end to end. Major product launches, operational improvement projects, and company-wide changes that touch every department. Own the plan, the dependencies, the risks, the communication, and the follow-through, so that the people doing the work know what they need to do and can focus on the work.
* Support the adoption of AI tools across the company. Not a mandate from above, but a real program: find where AI tooling makes people measurably more effective, help teams try it, learn what works, and spread it. Use AI yourself as a force multiplier in how you plan, communicate, and analyze.
* Be the Product Owner for an early-stage product experiment. We have one engineer dedicated to an early-stage internal tool that may have wider market opportunities. For at least the next six to twelve months, you will own the product side of that experiment: talk with internal and external stakeholders to vet which problems are worth solving, decide how to solve them and in what order, write clear requirements the engineer can build from, and build the evidence for whether there is a larger market. If it succeeds, we will hire a dedicated product manager to hand off to, and you will continue as our Senior Program Manager.
* Make priorities visible and tradeoffs explicit. Help leadership see what is in flight, what is competing for the same people, and what it costs to say yes to something new. Bring data and a point of view and let the executives make the call with clear information.
* Facilitate the Agile events and rituals that earn their keep. Planning, reviews, retrospectives, and the rhythms that keep teams aligned, tuned to what actually helps the team ship rather than what a framework prescribes.
* Build the operating cadence for the company. Quarterly planning, status reporting that people actually read, decision logs, and the handful of templates that make the next project easier than the last one. Document it well enough that it runs without you in the room.
* Partner with every function. Spend real time with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Implementation, Operations, Managed Services, Finance, Marketing, and People and Culture. Understand how each team works before suggesting how it could work better.
* Close the loop. When an initiative finishes, find out whether it delivered what it promised based on the metrics and success criteria established at kickoff. Run honest retrospectives and share what you learn to improve how we run the next one.
* Continuously learn and grow, in program management, in product thinking, and in how you help a company get better at getting things done.

**What We Are Looking For:**

* A practical thinker who knows the goal is a company that executes well, not a governance model for its own sake.
* A builder of just-enough process. Someone who has seen both ends of the spectrum, chaos and bureaucracy, and has a practiced instinct for the lightweight middle. You know that a process which is not followed is worse than no process at all.
* A practitioner of real Agile software development. You have worked inside teams that actually ship this way, and you understand the principles well enough to adapt the practices to the team instead of forcing the team to fit the practices.
* Someone with enough product instinct to own a product. You can sit with a customer, hear a problem underneath the request, decide what to build first, and write a requirement an engineer can act on without a meeting to decode it.
* A strong communicator who can brief an executive in two minutes, run a working session with a sales or operations team, and write a status update that people read all the way to the end. You follow up on your commitments and your questions.
* Someone who is enthusiastic about AI as an enabler, eager to experiment with AI-assisted tooling in your own work and to help others do the same, without abdicating judgment.
* A collaborator who earns trust across departments by being useful, not by holding authority. People should want you in the room because things go better when you are there.
* Someone who takes pride in enabling others and finds real satisfaction in a team finishing something big and knowing that your work under them made it easier.

* 10+ years of experience in program m

jobs.title: Civil Aviation Management Expert/Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Organizational Setting

Under the ICAO Capacity Development and Implementation Directorate (CDI), the Operations Section (FOS) is responsible for the strategic planning, development, execution, and evaluation of projects. FOS supports the identification of priority development needs in the civil aviation sector and offers technical cooperation to recipient States. FOS executes projects in accordance with ICAO/CDI policies and contractual modalities.

ICAO/CDI is supporting the Government of the Republic of Armenia in the institutional reform of the Civil Aviation Committee (CAC), as established in Project Document ARM24802. This project is implemented under the Management Service Agreement (MSA) signed between ICAO and the Government of Armenia on 8 March 2024.

Within this framework, the project provides structured technical assistance to transform the current CAC from a government department operating within civil service constraints into an autonomous, technically competent, and financially sustainable authority fully capable of fulfilling its safety oversight mandate in accordance with ICAO Standards and Recommended Practices (SARPs).

In addition, this project aims to support the necessary institutional reforms to increase effectiveness, sustainability, and independence of the AASIID.

**TECHNIAL CONTEXT**

Armenia's civil aviation sector is currently regulated by the Civil Aviation Committee (CAC), a government body operating within the State civil service framework. The CAC faces structural challenges that constrain its effectiveness as a safety oversight body: it operates under civil service HR frameworks that limit its ability to attract and retain qualified technical specialists; it is dependent on the state budget with limited cost-recovery mechanisms; and its primary legislation and regulatory framework require updating to align with applicable ICAO SARPs.

ICAO's Universal Safety Oversight Audit Program (USOAP) findings have identified gaps in Armenia's safety oversight capabilities that can only be sustainably resolved through fundamental institutional reform. The Government of Armenia, in cooperation with ICAO, has committed to transforming the CAC into an autonomous CAC capable of fulfilling its safety oversight mandate on a sustainable basis and to increase effectiveness, sustainability, and independence of the AASIID.

Project ARM24802 supports this transformation through three integrated reform pillars: (i) Institutional and Legislative Reform — establishing the legal, regulatory, and governance framework for an autonomous CAC and independent AASIID; (ii) Organizational, Administrative and Functional Review — restructuring the institution's organization, processes, and manuals; and (iii) Sustainable Financing and Human Resources Framework — establishing cost-recovery mechanisms and a competitive HR framework to attract and retain qualified staff.

**Major duties and Responsibilities**

In general terms, the activities contemplated in Project ARM24802 in which all team members will contribute include the following:

* Diagnostic Phase: Assessment of the current CAC's and AASIID’s legal, institutional, organizational, financial, and HR frameworks; review of USOAP findings and national legislative context.

* Reform Design Phase: Development of reform recommendations, legislative drafts, organizational models, financial frameworks, and HR policies aligned with ICAO SARPs, related guidance and best practices. as applicable.

* Implementation Support Phase: Technical assistance to CAC and AASIID in implementing approved reforms, including staff capacity building and stakeholder engagement.

Function 1 (incl. Expected results)

* Lead and coordinate the work of the expert team, ensuring coherent and timely delivery across all three reform pillars and all project objectives.
* Oversee all project activities and deliverables in close coordination with the ICAO CDI and ICAO EUR/NAT Responsible Officers and the National Project Coordinator.
* Conduct a senior-level diagnostic assessment of the current CAC as an institution, covering governance, management, accountability, and operational performance.
* Develop the overall CAC reform design, including governance model, management structure, board or advisory committee arrangements, accountability mechanisms, and transition strategy.
* Advise on CAC operational management models: strategic planning, performance management, regulatory decision-making, and reporting frameworks.
* Lead high-level stakeholder engagement with the Ministry, current CAC and AASIID senior leadership, other Government entities, as applicable.
* Develop the CAC Transition Strategy and Implementation Roadmap, integrating legal, financial, organizational, and HR reform components.
Ensure quality and coherence across all project deliverables, reviewing and integrating contributions from all five experts.

Function 2 (incl. Expected results)

* Coordinate the duties of all experts as a Project Coordinator to achieve the project objectives to the best of their ability.
* When necessary, contribute to the review and harmonization of sections developed by other members of the expert team.
* Compile the necessary documentation to carry out the work.
* Prepare meetings and field visits appropriately, including preparing lists of stakeholders to be consulted, questionnaires, and corresponding visit and meeting reports.
* Participate in coordination meetings organized by the ICAO CDI and EUR/NAT Responsible Officers and the National Project Coordinator.
* Ensure that ICAO's safety, security, and sustainability considerations applicable to the various work areas are incorporated into all deliverables.

The Quality and Operations Analyst is responsible for managing and supporting the end-to-end onboarding and data integration process for customers and vendors, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant exchange of point-of-sale and operational data. This role serves as a key operational bridge between customers, vendors, and internal teams by enabling seamless onboarding experiences and reliable downstream data availability.

  

This position ensures data integrity, consistency, and usability by validating incoming data, resolving discrepancies, and supporting structured data transformation into actionable business information. **About Scene Health**

Scene is reimagining medication adherence with our 360° model of care, bringing the gold standard of Directly Observed Therapy into the digital age. Through personalized video coaching, engaging education, and motivational support, we connect healthcare professionals, patients, and their families to solve the $500B problem of medication nonadherence.  
  
Through our mobile app, patients connect with pharmacists, nurses, and health coaches through quick daily video check-ins, anytime, anywhere. We make medication management engaging and supportive while helping patients overcome challenges and barriers related to social determinants of health.

**Job Overview**  
  
Scene Health is on a mission to solve medication non-adherence. We’re a diverse team of designers, technologists, researchers, and public health enthusiasts committed to building high-impact technology that helps patients get better faster.

Scene provides a platform of mobile and web-based applications used in the US and abroad, which means a wide variety of work day-to-day. Our team is constantly taking on challenging and exciting problems, with the goal of making a serious impact on the lives of patients. We work with world-renowned clinicians and scientists to help patients facing significant health challenges. Our solution is offered to patients with infectious and chronic diseases such as tuberculosis, HIV, hepatitis C, opioid addiction/substance abuse, diabetes, asthma, and mental health. We partner with academic medical centers and adherence experts across the country to develop and validate our tech-enabled solution.

We are looking for a passionate and motivated Patient Engagement Specialist for Research and Clinical Trials, who will deliver Scene’s digital adherence monitoring programs for academic and commercial research partners reporting to the Associate Program Manager. You will help study participants take their first critical steps toward better health. Scene serves patients virtually with chronic and behavioral health conditions. Our clinical pilot and trial management customers and their participants value meaningful support and engagement that is delivered routinely and rapidly.

In this role, you will be involved in programs to support research studies and clinical trials to deliver asynchronous monitoring of participants’ medication adherence to investigational study drugs and novel interventions. The Patient Engagement Specialist’s role involves helping research and clinical trial study sites and their patients begin a standardized medication adherence program that will help them track their progress, and establishing a responsive routine of documenting participant medication adherence. Starting and finishing strong in the monitoring program is paramount to study success.

You will also be involved in clinical programs monitoring patients’ adherence to prescription medications as a part of routine care. These programs can include populations with substance use disorders, chronic illnesses and mental health conditions. We take an engaging approach to motivate patients toward lasting change for healthy outcomes.

We are a distributed team with collaborations all over the country, so this is a remote position. If you’re an empathetic and passionate individual who loves interacting with patients and clients, wants to help others, and cares about impacting the community, we’d love to hear from you!

**Responsibilities**

* Completes daily reviews of all patient video submissions when ingesting medications, and responds as appropriate per engagement and escalation protocols, and documents actions taken
* Updates and maintains a database of patient-level notes daily
* Conducts data entry, data quality check, and data reconciliation exercises to ensure consistent documentation
* Conducts technical training with study sites to help patients use Scene Health’s mobile application and to resolve technical challenges when using the web platform
* Prepares written reports and maintains records of program monitoring activities
* Works collaboratively with a cross-functional team to identify, develop, evaluate, and refine new processes and features of the Scene Health program
* Provides management with patient feedback and/or recommendations for program and product improvement
* Other duties as assigned

**Required Qualifications:**

* 3-5 years of related experience
* High school diploma
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Proficiency with database systems and mobile applications
* Bilingual in English and Spanish

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a healthcare related field or equivalent experience
* Experience in a healthcare, clinical research, or a digital health setting
* Familiarity or experience with substance use/abuse and mental health care and programs, especially recovery support services and peer support approaches
* Directly Observed Therapy, peer counseling, or other community health work experience
* Open to alternative work schedules

*Note: Interested candidates should be prepared to provide references as a part of the interview process.*

**\*\*We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas at this time**.

jobs.title: Foodstream Learn, Nutrition & Culinary Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
FoodStream Learn is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Program Manager to oversee the strategic coordination and operational execution of our food education programs in NYC public schools.

### **About FOODSTREAM**

At Foodstream, we are building the intelligence layer of food security, connecting people, data, and technology to move food faster, smarter, and more equitably. As a mission-driven, for-profit social enterprise, we use digital infrastructure to link the entire food recovery ecosystem, from donors and distributors to transportation providers and community organizations. Our work operates across two core verticals: Foodstream Learn, an NYC Department of Education–approved program that delivers food literacy and sustainability education in schools and Foodstream Network, which powers real-time food movement and impact tracking. Together, these platforms create a unified model that combines technology, education, and collaboration to reduce waste, expand access, and strengthen community resilience.

### **Description**

### **FoodStream Learn, Nutrition & Culinary Senior Program Manager**

Location: New York City (Remote with regular onsite visits)

* Type: Part-time/Contractor

Compensation: $30 - $40 per hour, based on experience

**About the Role**

FoodStream Learn is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Program Manager to oversee the strategic coordination and operational execution of our food education programs in NYC public schools. This leadership role involves supervising program staff and educators, managing school partnerships, ensuring program quality and compliance, and supporting program expansion. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator, leader, and systems thinker with a track record in education or nonprofit program management.

**Responsibilities**

* Program Leadership: Oversee all aspects of program implementation, ensuring alignment with FoodStream’s mission and educational standards.
* Team Management: Supervise and support junior coordinators, assistants, and educators; lead onboarding, training, and ongoing team development.
* School Partnerships: Maintain and grow relationships with school leaders, administrators, and DOE liaisons; manage communications and problem-solving.
* Logistics & Scheduling: Manage high-level logistics, oversee program calendars across school sites, and ensure all resources (staff, materials, curriculum, etc.) are in place.
* Curriculum Oversight: Collaborate with curriculum developers and educators to align content with school needs, DOE standards, and inclusive teaching practices.
* Monitoring & Evaluation: Lead data collection, impact reporting, and feedback processes to assess program effectiveness and areas for improvement.
* Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure programs meet health, safety, and quality guidelines; troubleshoot operational issues as needed.
* Strategic Development: Support grant reporting, partner communications, and long-term planning for program growth and sustainability.

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Program Management, Public Health, or related field (Master’s preferred)
* 4+ years of experience in program management, school partnerships, or nonprofit operations
* Experience supervising teams or managing junior staff
* Strong leadership, planning, and conflict resolution skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Comfort managing multiple projects and school relationships simultaneously
* Proficiency with Google Suite and project management tools (e.g., Airtable, Trello, Asana)
* Access to own transport, valid NY State driver license and computer in good working order

**Preferred:**

* Experience working with NYC public schools or DOE programming
* Familiarity with food education, nutrition, or sustainability
* Bilingual (Spanish/English)
* Experience designing or overseeing curriculum and educator training

**Hours & Contract Details**

* Part-time contract position with flexible scheduling based on school program needs and team oversight
* Hourly compensation of $30 - $40, based on experience and qualifications
* Opportunity to shape program direction and grow within a mission-driven organization

**How to Apply**

Please submit your application via the job post. Thank you.

**About FoodStream**

FoodStream Network (FSN) is a pioneering organization dedicated to transforming food access, education, and distribution through innovative programs and technology-driven solutions.

* FoodStream Learn (FSL) is a DOE-certified food education program that integrates cooking, gardening, and interactive learning to teach food literacy, sustainability, and healthy habits. It empowers individuals—especially students and communities—with the knowledge and skills needed to make informed food choices, grow their own food, and adopt sustainable practices.
* FoodStream Network (FSN) is a digital platform designed to enhance the efficiency and impact of community organizations working to address food insecurity. We connect nonprofits, food industry stakeholders, and community groups to streamline food distribution, reduce waste, and increase access to nutritious food.

#### **Salary**

$30 - $40 per hour

jobs.title: Customer Experience Manager
jobs.description:
**Customer Experience Manager**

**Remote.** Open to candidates anywhere in the United States. This is a remote customer experience and customer service leadership role.

Full-time. Pay $72,800 to $93,600 per year

**Before you apply, read these. If any of these are true, this is not the right role for you.**

You have used a customer service platform but have never configured it yourself. You have never built rules, automations, macros, or views.

You cannot point to a specific process you built that saved measurable time or money.

You have never managed or trained direct reports.

Your answer to every customer complaint is a refund.

**About the role**

We are a hemp manufacturer and ecommerce company selling direct to consumers through Shopify and wholesale to businesses. Customer service is handled by a small team covering both channels, and we are looking for the person who will own that function end to end. This role is also commonly titled Customer Service Manager, Customer Support Manager, or CX Operations Manager, and we welcome applicants from any of those backgrounds.

Most of your time will be spent building and optimizing the customer support platform. We run Gorgias as our helpdesk and ticketing system. That means the automations, rules, macros, tags, views, routing logic, chatbot and AI agent configuration, and the self-service resources customers use before they ever open a ticket. You are the technical owner of this stack. You are not just working inside a helpdesk someone else set up. You are the one designing it.

Alongside that, you own the customer experience model itself. You will analyze what our current policies cost us and what they save us, design workflows that protect the business from fraud and abuse, and build a CX program that is genuinely better than standard customer service. We want someone who thinks past the script.

You will also train and lead the team. That includes onboarding new representatives, coaching in real time, running one on ones, and giving direct feedback when something is not working.

**How this role changes over time**

This role changes shape. In the beginning it is heavily focused on setup and build: configuring the platform, designing automations, creating self-service resources, and documenting how the team works. As that foundation gets built, the role shifts toward handling outlier cases, approving the calls the team cannot make on their own, and working more tickets hands-on. We want someone who is excited by both phases, not just one.

**Where your time goes in the first year**

Platform architecture and automation, 35 percent

Service model, policy, and process design, 20 percent

Team leadership, training, and feedback, 20 percent

Hands-on ticket work, 15 percent

Tracking, reporting, and escalating customer feedback, 10 percent

**What you will actually do**

Build, test, and maintain automations, rules, triggers, macros, tags, views, and routing logic.

Audit the existing configuration continuously. Kill what does not fire, fix what misroutes, retire what nobody uses.

Own the AI and intent setup. Decide what the bot answers, what it escalates, and audit its accuracy on a set schedule.

Own customer-facing self-service: help center, FAQs, chatbot flows, contact form, and troubleshooting content.

Analyze what existing policies cost and what they save, and bring recommendations with data behind them.

Build fraud-resistant workflows, including repeat-claim detection and evidence requirements.

Write, refine, and enforce the standard operating procedures the team follows.

Onboard and train new representatives against a documented ramp plan.

Coach to specific examples in real time and hold the team accountable to the process and the numbers.

Work tickets daily alongside your team, and own escalations and complex business-to-business issues.

Report weekly on performance with insight, not just numbers, and escalate urgent issues immediately.

Flag legal, compliance, and regulatory risk when you spot it in ticket language, policy wording, or process gaps.

**What we are looking for**

Provable hands-on experience building inside a customer service or helpdesk platform. Gorgias is strongly preferred. Zendesk, Kustomer, Front, Intercom, or similar will be considered if you have done real configuration work, not just ticket handling.

Experience configuring or auditing an AI agent or chatbot in a support environment.

Experience managing, training, and giving performance feedback to direct reports.

A track record of auditing, creating, and improving customer service policies, with results you can describe.

Comfort with Shopify and ecommerce systems, and the ability to work across fulfillment, finance, and web teams.

Strong writing. Most of our customer communication is written.

**Interview process**

The interview includes technical questions on automation logic and agentic AI workflows. You will be asked to explain in detail how you understand these and to walk through builds you have personally done. You will also be asked for specific examples of coaching a direct report and of a policy you created or improved.

Pay: $72,800.00 - $93,600.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Months of hands-on experience in a CX platform.
* Which CX platforms do you have expert-level experience in, and how long in each?
* Have you built automations of workflow rules from scratch? Interview includes technical questions.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason. Our team solves critical network challenges for some of the world's largest organizations. In simple terms, we manage the systems that keep networks running smoothly, securely, and reliably—the backbone infrastructure that powers digital transformation for enterprises globally. Our Intelligent Network Operations platform delivers and enables AI-driven agentic ops at scale, automating and simplifying how companies manage, secure, and optimize their networks.

But what makes us different is how we work: we believe great work happens in an environment where you're trusted, heard, and supported. With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.

As a Customer Success Manager, you serve a shared portfolio of customers alongside your teammates rather than owning a named list of your own. Any customer in the pool may be yours on any given day, and your job is to make that experience feel seamless to them.

This is a different craft from named account management. You work from a prioritized queue driven by health signals, product usage, support activity, and renewal proximity. You load context quickly, diagnose accurately, deliver value in a compressed number of touchpoints, and leave the account better documented than you found it so the next teammate can pick up exactly where you left off.

  

You are equally comfortable walking a network operations lead through a product capability and explaining business impact to a director. You thrive on variety and volume, and you take pride in doing high-quality work at pace.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Shared Portfolio Coverage & Customer Engagement**

* Serve customers across a shared portfolio, working from a prioritized queue rather than a fixed account list.
* Deliver proactive lifecycle touchpoints, including onboarding confirmation, adoption checkpoints, and structured pre-renewal reviews.
* Respond to inbound customer needs within team coverage standards and see them through to resolution.
* Build credibility quickly with new stakeholders, often without the benefit of an established relationship.
* Be the voice of the customer internally, using the breadth of the pool to spot patterns a single account view would miss.

**Product & Technical Enablement**

* Guide customers on best practices, implementation planning, and usage optimization.
* Deliver product demonstrations to drive adoption and unlock new use cases.
* Collaborate with Support and Product teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
* Translate technical capability into business outcomes the customer cares about.

**Value Realization at Scale**

* Execute standardized success plays consistently and well, adapting the message rather than rebuilding the motion.
* Confirm that every customer you touch has clear, documented outcomes they are working toward.
* Connect product adoption to tangible business results in every customer conversation.
* Contribute improvements to the plays themselves based on what you see working in the field.

**Retention, Risk & Renewal Readiness**

* Detect churn risk early through health signals, usage decline, support friction, and stakeholder change.
* Run structured pre-renewal reviews and prepare a clear readiness picture for each upcoming renewal.
* Hand off renewals to the Renewals CSM with complete context, including value delivered, open risks, stakeholder map, and expansion signals.
* Identify cross-sell and up-sell opportunities and route them to Sales with the supporting evidence.

**Operational Excellence**

* Maintain rigorous documentation so account context lives in the system rather than in individual memory. This is the foundation of the pooled model.
* Keep data accurate and current in internal systems, including Totango and Salesforce.
* Manage many concurrent customer conversations without letting commitments slip.
* Contribute to team KPIs, including coverage, response time, adoption, health score, and retention.

**What You Bring**

* 2 to 4 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Technical Support, or a similar customer-facing role in B2B SaaS.
* A balance of technical aptitude and business acumen. You can speak both languages. Exposure to networking, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, or infrastructure is an asset.
* Comfort serving many customers at once and prioritizing by signal rather than by relationship history.
* Excellent written communication. A significant share of pooled engagement happens asynchronously, and your writing carries the relationship.
* Strong documentation habits and genuine discipline about leaving a clean trail for teammates.
* Experience delivering demos and running structured customer conversations.
* Familiarity with CS and CRM tooling, such as Totango or Salesforce.
* A proactive mindset: driven, accountable, coachable, and naturally customer-obsessed.

This position offers a base salary range of $87,000 - $110,000 USD per year plus participation in a discretionary bonus plan. Final compensation will be based on skills, experience, and qualifications. The role is for an existing vacancy.

If you share our enthusiasm for the future of our company and are eager to contribute to our vibrant workplace, we look forward to receiving your application!

This position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; tax advantaged accounts (HSA, FSA); annual Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA); a 401(k) with company matching; paid parental leave; vacation, personal, and wellness days; an annual learning and development budget. Eligible employees may also participate in the company's annual bonus program.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Harper**
----------------

Harper is one runtime for any workload. We combine database, cache, application logic, real-time messaging, and APIs into a single process, so enterprise teams can retire a stack of point solutions and serve data in about a millisecond. Brands like Macy's, Ralph Lauren, Verizon, HP, Ford and Bass Pro Shops run on Harper, and we sell and deliver alongside partners including Akamai. www.harper.fast (http://www.harper.fast)

**The role**
============

You own retention and growth across a focused book of Harper's most strategic enterprise accounts, with revenue targets tied to renewals and expansion. Strong relationships on the customer side and inside Harper mean you're the first to know when something isn't going to plan, and your project management discipline gets it back on track.

This is not a technical support role. Harper's engineers, forward-deployed engineers, and partner support teams own the technical work. You orchestrate them: route each ask through the right process, bring in the right people before the customer has to ask, and make sure nothing falls between the customer, Harper, and our partners. You'll need enough product fluency to match Harper's capabilities to a customer's business needs and to recognize when an issue needs engineering.

The best person for this seat has grown large, multi-stakeholder enterprise accounts and has the renewal and expansion numbers to show for it. You're a highly organized operator who takes personal ownership of outcomes. You write a clear weekly update without being asked, you prepare a day ahead rather than an hour ahead, and you spot the next expansion opportunity before the customer's team does.

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Own the account**

* Be the single accountable owner for some of our most strategic enterprise accounts, from day-to-day status through renewal and expansion, partnering with Sales leadership on pricing and approvals.
* Know each account cold and keep a written plan for it: history, champions, what was piloted and promised, open commitments, risks, renewal date, and expansion opportunities.
* Keep a finger on the pulse of every live implementation. Track adoption and usage, and make sure customers get full value from Harper so it never becomes shelfware.
* Stay relevant as customer priorities shift. Know their roadmap, connect Harper to their new initiatives, and advocate for what's right for their architecture.

**Run the work like a project manager**

* Run active customer initiatives (pilots, upgrades, migrations, rollouts) with a clear plan, owners, and dates, and track every open item to closure. When a follow-up is owed, it goes out within one business day.
* Flag risk early and loudly. If a deal, pilot, or deliverable is stalled on the customer, a partner, or Harper, you say so in the right channel and keep pushing until it moves.
* Keep a steady operating rhythm: agendas sent ahead of every customer and internal sync, notes and action items sent the same day, and a Monday plan and Friday wrap-up to the team each week.

**Manage relationships across three sides**

* Build multi-threaded relationships with champions, executives, procurement, and project leads at each customer, and navigate reorgs and leadership changes so every account always has an active champion and executive sponsor.
* Partner with our channel partners' account teams as true co-owners. Keep them informed on scope, services, and billing, and build the relationship before you need it.
* Coordinate commercial items such as professional services scopes, SOWs, and contracts, so work is never delivered without paper.

**Orchestrate Harper's internal team**

* Route technical questions through the established support and escalation paths, and bring the right Harper experts into customer conversations, brief them in advance, and own the follow-up afterward.
* Write customer-facing documents (responses, recaps, QBR decks, and proposals) that are accurate, complete, and reviewed before they go out.
* Bring customer feedback, references, and case studies back to Product and Marketing.

  
  

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

**Must-haves**

* 6+ years managing enterprise accounts in B2B software with Fortune 500 customers, multiple stakeholders per account, and a track record of negotiating renewals and expansions against a quota.
* Real project management experience: you have run customer rollouts, pilots, or implementations with plans, owners, dates and status reporting.
* Experience working with or through channel partners, resellers, or alliance partners on shared accounts.
* Excellent communication skills. Your recaps, updates, and customer documents are clear, accurate and ready to send.
* You can connect a customer's goals to the right product capabilities and spot expansion opportunities from their technical roadmap.
* Fluency with a CRM and a project tracker (for example, HubSpot or Salesforce, and Asana).
* Experience at a startup or small team, where you built the process instead of waiting for one.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience with data infrastructure, CDN, cloud or developer platforms.
* Accounts in retail, e-commerce, media or telecom.
* Experience scoping and contracting professional services or SOWs.
* A PMP, CSM or similar project management credential.
* Experience with Harper

**This role is not for you if**
-------------------------------

* You prefer hunting new logos over growing within existing customers.
* You need a manager to remind you about follow-ups or deadlines.
* You would rather escalate a problem than own it.
* You prefer a slower-paced environment where the day-to-day is predictable. Here, priorities shift with customer needs, and you'll be juggling several accounts and initiatives at once.

**Job Summary**

The **Clinical Care Manager** provides holistic clinical care management services for members across the continuum of care through comprehensive assessment, care planning, education, care coordination, advocacy, and ongoing monitoring. The Clinical Care Manager works collaboratively with members, families, providers, community organizations, and multidisciplinary care teams to improve health outcomes, promote self-management, address barriers to care, and ensure appropriate utilization of healthcare services.

  

The Clinical Care Manager supports diverse member populations, including individuals with chronic and complex medical conditions, behavioral health comorbidities, special health care needs, maternal-child health needs, newborns with complex medical conditions, high-risk and priority populations, individuals experiencing homelessness, and members requiring intensive care coordination across multiple systems of care.

  

Utilizing telephonic outreach, virtual engagement, data analysis, and face-to-face visits, the Clinical Care Manager conducts assessments, develops individualized care plans, coordinates services, and promotes member engagement through evidence-based practices and motivational interviewing techniques. * Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with quoting tools and ERP/CRM systems, such as Syteline and Pipeline.

The Account Manager for Smart Manufacturing & Industry 4.0 is responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding strategic relationships, and positioning Siemon as the preferred physical layer partner across automation, robotics, industrial networking, and digital factory environments. This role focuses on developing and managing accounts within the Industry 4.0 ecosystem — including OEMs, system integrators, industrial distributors, and manufacturing end users.
